title.zh: 卷五十 志第三上: 五行一
title.raw: 卷五十 志第三上: 五行一 Volume 50 Treatises 3: Five Elements 1

sentences.zh: 五行一

translations.literal: Five Elements One
translations.idiomatic: Five Elements, Part One

sentences.zh: 人與天地，參為三極，災祥之興，各以類至。

translations.literal: Man together with Heaven and Earth participate as the three poles; when calamities and auspices arise, each arrives according to its kind.
translations.idiomatic: Humanity, Heaven, and Earth together form the three ultimates; when disaster or good fortune appears, each comes in accord with its proper category.

sentences.zh: 天之五運，地之五材，其用不窮，其初一陰陽耳，陰陽一太極耳。

translations.literal: Heaven's five movements and Earth's five materials—their uses are inexhaustible; at root they are but yin and yang, and yin and yang are but the Grand Ultimate.
translations.idiomatic: The five revolutions of Heaven and the five resources of Earth have inexhaustible applications, yet in essence they reduce to yin and yang alone, and yin and yang in turn are nothing but the Great Ultimate.

sentences.zh: 而人之生也，全付畀有之，具為五性，著為五事，又著為五德，修之則吉，不修則凶，吉則致福焉，不吉則致極焉。

translations.literal: As for man's birth, he is entirely entrusted with these; equipped with the five natures, manifested as the five affairs, and further manifested as the five virtues—to cultivate them is auspicious, not to cultivate them is inauspicious; what is auspicious brings blessing, what is inauspicious brings extremity.
translations.idiomatic: In human life, all of this is fully bestowed: the five natures are embodied, the five affairs are displayed, and the five virtues are made manifest. To cultivate them is fortunate; to neglect them is disastrous. Fortune brings blessings, while misfortune brings ruin to the extreme.

sentences.zh: 征之於天，吉則休征之所應也，不吉則咎征之所應也。

translations.literal: Verified against Heaven, when auspicious, the auspicious signs correspond; when inauspicious, the blame signs correspond.
translations.idiomatic: When tested against Heaven, good conduct draws corresponding signs of favor, while bad conduct draws corresponding signs of calamity.

sentences.zh: 天地之氣，無感不應，天地之氣應，亦無物不感，而況天子建中和之極，身為神人之主，而心範圍天地之妙，其精神常與造化相流通，若桴鼓然。

translations.literal: The qi of Heaven and Earth—where there is no stimulus there is no response; when the qi of Heaven and Earth responds, nothing fails to be stimulated; moreover, the Son of Heaven establishes the pinnacle of central harmony and is himself master of spirits and men, while his mind encompasses the subtlety of Heaven and Earth—his spirit constantly interflows with creation and transformation, like drum and mallet.
translations.idiomatic: The vital forces of Heaven and Earth respond to every stimulus and stir every thing in turn. How much more is this true of the Son of Heaven, who establishes the supreme standard of central harmony, stands as lord of spirits and humanity, and whose mind embraces the subtle workings of Heaven and Earth—his spirit constantly communes with creation itself, as intimately as drumstick and drumhead.

sentences.zh: 故軒轅氏治五氣，高陽氏建五官，夏後氏修六府，自身而推之於國，莫不有政焉。

translations.literal: Therefore the Yellow Emperor regulated the five qi, Gaoyang established the five officers, and the Xia sovereign cultivated the six treasuries—from oneself extending to the state, nowhere was there not government.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the Yellow Emperor regulated the five vital forces, Emperor Zhuanxu established the five offices, and the Xia rulers maintained the six treasuries—extending governance from the person to the state, so that government pervaded every sphere.

sentences.zh: 其後箕子因之，以衍九疇，其言天人之際備矣。

translations.literal: Afterward Jizi followed this to develop the Nine Categories; his words on the boundary between Heaven and man were complete.
translations.idiomatic: Later Jizi built upon this tradition to elaborate the Nine Categories, and his account of the relationship between Heaven and humanity was comprehensive.

sentences.zh: 漢儒不明其大要，如夏侯勝、劉向父子，競以災異言之，班固以來采為《五行志》，又不考求向之論著本於伏生。

translations.literal: Han scholars did not understand its main points; such men as Xiahou Sheng and Liu Xiang and his son competed to speak of calamities and anomalies; from Ban Gu onward this was collected into the Treatise on the Five Elements, yet they did not investigate that Liu Xiang's writings derived from Fu Sheng.
translations.idiomatic: Han scholars failed to grasp the essential doctrine. Men such as Xiahou Sheng and Liu Xiang and his son vied to explain everything through portents and anomalies; from Ban Gu onward these were compiled into the Treatise on the Five Elements, yet no one traced Liu Xiang's theories back to their source in Fu Sheng.

sentences.zh: 生之《大傳》言：「六沴作見，若是共禦，五福乃降；

translations.literal: Fu Sheng's Great Tradition says: "When the six aberrations appear, if one jointly guards against them, the five blessings will descend;
translations.idiomatic: Fu Sheng's Great Tradition states: "When the six aberrations manifest, if all join in warding them off, the five blessings will descend;

sentences.zh: 若不共禦，六極其下。

translations.literal: if one does not jointly guard against them, the six extremities will befall below."
translations.idiomatic: if they are not jointly warded off, the six extremities will fall upon you."

sentences.zh: 禹乃共辟厥德，爰用五事，建用王極。

translations.literal: Yu then jointly cultivated his virtue, thereby employing the five affairs and establishing the royal pinnacle.
translations.idiomatic: Yu thereupon jointly cultivated his virtue, applied the five affairs, and established the royal pinnacle.

sentences.zh: 」後世君不建極，臣不加省，顧乃執其類而求之，惑矣。

translations.literal: "Later generations' rulers did not establish the pinnacle, ministers did not add reflection, yet instead clung to categories to seek them—how confused!
translations.idiomatic: "Later rulers failed to establish the pinnacle, and ministers offered no self-examination, yet instead clung to categories in their search—how misguided!

sentences.zh: 否則判而二焉，如宋儒王安石之論，亦過也。

translations.literal: Otherwise they divided them into two, as in the Song scholar Wang Anshi's discourse—this too was excessive.
translations.idiomatic: Or they split Heaven and humanity into two separate realms, as in the discourse of the Song scholar Wang Anshi—this too went too far.

sentences.zh: 天人感應之機，豈易言哉！

translations.literal: The mechanism of mutual resonance between Heaven and man—how can it be spoken of easily!
translations.idiomatic: The mechanism by which Heaven and humanity respond to one another—how easily can that be put into words!

sentences.zh: 故無變而無不修省者，上也；

translations.literal: Therefore those who without omens still do not fail to cultivate and reflect are the highest;
translations.idiomatic: Those who cultivate themselves and reflect even when no portent appears rank highest;

sentences.zh: 因變而克自修省者，次之；

translations.literal: those who because of omens are able to cultivate and reflect themselves are next;
translations.idiomatic: those who, when portents appear, are able to reform themselves rank next;

sentences.zh: 災變既形，修之而莫知所以修，省之而莫知所以省，又次之；

translations.literal: when calamities and omens have already taken form, to cultivate yet not know how to cultivate, to reflect yet not know how to reflect—this is again lower;
translations.idiomatic: when disasters and portents have already manifested, yet one cultivates without knowing how, or reflects without knowing how—this ranks lower still;

sentences.zh: 其下者，災變並至，敗亡隨之，訖莫修省者，刑戮之民是已。

translations.literal: The lowest: calamities and omens arrive together, defeat and ruin follow, and to the end there is no cultivation or reflection—such are the people of punishment and execution.
translations.idiomatic: Lowest of all are those upon whom disasters and portents descend together and ruin follows, yet who never cultivate or reflect to the end—such are the people destined for punishment and death.

sentences.zh: 歷考往古存亡之故，不越是數者。

translations.literal: Examining through history the causes of survival and destruction in antiquity, none go beyond these several categories.
translations.idiomatic: A survey of the causes of rise and fall throughout antiquity shows that none fall outside these few categories.

sentences.zh: 元起朔漠，方太祖西征，角端見於東印度，為人語云「汝主宜早還」，意者天告之以止殺也。

translations.literal: The Yuan arose from the northern desert; just as the Taizu was campaigning westward, the jiaoduan appeared in eastern India and spoke in human language, saying "Your lord should return early"—presumably Heaven was telling him to cease killing.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan dynasty rose from the northern steppe. While the Taizu was campaigning westward, the jiaoduan beast appeared in eastern India and spoke in a human voice: "Your lord should return at once"—presumably Heaven was warning him to halt the slaughter.

sentences.zh: 憲宗討八赤蠻於寬田吉思海，會大風，吹海水盡涸，濟師大捷，憲宗以為「天導我也」。

translations.literal: Emperor Xianzong attacked the Badai Bachi in the Kuanting Jisi Sea; a great wind arose and blew the seawater dry, the army crossed and won a great victory—Emperor Xianzong took this as "Heaven guiding me."
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xianzong campaigned against the Badai Bachi at Lake Kuanting Jisi, a great wind arose and blew the seawater dry. His army crossed and won a great victory, and the emperor declared, "Heaven is guiding me."

sentences.zh: 以此見五方不殊性，其於畏天，有不待教而能者。

translations.literal: From this one sees that the five directions do not differ in nature; in revering Heaven, there are those who can do so without awaiting instruction.
translations.idiomatic: From this one sees that the peoples of the five directions share the same nature: in reverence for Heaven, some need no teaching to know what to do.

sentences.zh: 世祖兼有天下，方地既廣，郡邑災變，蓋不絕書，而妖孽禍眚，非有司言狀，則亦不得具見。

translations.literal: When Emperor Shizu united the realm under heaven, as the territory had grown vast, calamities and omens in commanderies and districts were constantly recorded; yet demonic portents and disasters, unless reported in detail by the responsible offices, could not be fully seen.
translations.idiomatic: After Emperor Shizu united the realm, the empire's territory had grown vast. Calamities and portents in commanderies and districts were recorded without cease, yet demonic anomalies and disasters could not be fully documented unless the responsible offices reported them in detail.

sentences.zh: 昔孔子作《春秋》，所紀災異多矣，然不著其事應；

translations.literal: Formerly when Confucius composed the Spring and Autumn Annals, the calamities and anomalies he recorded were many, yet he did not set down their corresponding events;
translations.idiomatic: When Confucius composed the Spring and Autumn Annals, he recorded many calamities and portents, yet he did not spell out what events they foretold;

sentences.zh: 聖人之知猶天也，故不妄意天，欲人深自謹焉。

translations.literal: the sage's knowledge was like Heaven's, therefore he did not presumptuously interpret Heaven, wishing people to be deeply self-cautious.
translations.idiomatic: the sage's knowledge was like that of Heaven itself, and so he did not presume to interpret Heaven's will, wishing instead that people would examine themselves with the utmost care.

sentences.zh: 乃本《洪範》，仿《春秋》之意，考次當時之災祥，作《五行志》。

translations.literal: Therefore based on the Great Plan, imitating the intent of the Spring and Autumn Annals, I arrange in sequence the calamities and auspices of the time and compose this Treatise on the Five Elements.
translations.idiomatic: Accordingly, taking the Great Plan as foundation and following the spirit of the Spring and Autumn Annals, I have arranged the calamities and auspices of our own age in chronological order and composed this Treatise on the Five Elements.

sentences.zh: 五行，一曰水。

translations.literal: Of the Five Elements, the first is Water.
translations.idiomatic: Of the Five Elements, the first is Water.

sentences.zh: 潤下，水之性也。

translations.literal: Moistening and descending—this is Water's nature.
translations.idiomatic: To moisten and descend is the nature of Water.

sentences.zh: 失其性為沴，時則霧水暴出，百川逆溢，壞鄉邑，溺人民，及凡霜雹之變，是為水不潤下。

translations.literal: When it loses its nature it becomes an aberration; at such times fog and water burst forth, the hundred streams overflow in reverse, destroying villages and towns and drowning the people, and all changes such as frost and hail—this is Water not moistening and descending.
translations.idiomatic: When Water loses its nature, aberration follows: mists and floods burst forth, rivers reverse their course and overflow, villages are destroyed and people drowned, and frost and hail appear—all signs that Water is no longer moistening and descending.

sentences.zh: 其征恒寒，其色黑，是為黑眚黑祥。

translations.literal: Its sign is constant cold, its color black—this is black calamity and black auspice.
translations.idiomatic: Its portent is unrelenting cold, its color black—these are the black calamities and black auspices.

sentences.zh: 至元元年，真定、順天、河間、順德、大名、東平、濟南等郡大水。

translations.literal: Zhiyuan year 1, the commanderies of Zhending, Shuntian, Hejian, Shunde, Daming, Dongping, Jinan, and others suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Zhiyuan reign period, great floods struck the commanderies of Zhending, Shuntian, Hejian, Shunde, Daming, Dongping, Jinan, and others.

sentences.zh: 四年五月，應州大水。

translations.literal: Year 4, fifth month, Yingzhou suffered a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fourth year, Yingzhou was inundated.

sentences.zh: 五年八月，亳州大水。

translations.literal: Year 5, eighth month, Bozhou suffered a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fifth year, Bozhou was inundated.

sentences.zh: 六年十二月，獻、莫、清、滄四州及豐州、渾源縣大水。

translations.literal: Year 6, twelfth month, the four prefectures of Xian, Mo, Qing, and Cang, and Fengzhou and Hunyuan County suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the sixth year, great floods struck the four prefectures of Xian, Mo, Qing, and Cang, along with Fengzhou and Hunyuan County.

sentences.zh: 九年九月，南陽、懷孟、衛輝、順天等郡，洺、磁、泰安、通、灤等州淫雨，河水並溢，圮田廬，害稼。

translations.literal: Year 9, ninth month, the commanderies of Nanyang, Huaimeng, Weihui, Shuntian, and others, and the prefectures of Ming, Ci, Tai'an, Tong, and Luan suffered excessive rain; rivers all overflowed, collapsing fields and dwellings and harming the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the ninth year, excessive rains fell on the commanderies of Nanyang, Huaimeng, Weihui, and Shuntian and on the prefectures of Ming, Ci, Tai'an, Tong, and Luan. Rivers overflowed everywhere, fields and houses were destroyed, and crops were ruined.

sentences.zh: 十三年十二月，濟寧及高麗沈州水。

translations.literal: Year 13, twelfth month, Jining and Korea's Shenzhou suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the thirteenth year, Jining and Shenzhou in Korea were flooded.

sentences.zh: 十四年六月，濟寧路雨水，平地丈餘，損稼。

translations.literal: Year 14, sixth month, Jining Circuit suffered rain; the water stood more than a zhang on level ground and damaged the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fourteenth year, rain flooded Jining Circuit to a depth of more than ten feet on level ground, destroying the crops.

sentences.zh: 曹州定陶、武清二縣，濮州、堂邑縣雨水，沒禾稼。

translations.literal: Caozhou's Dingtao and Wuqing counties, Puzhou, and Tangyi County suffered rain and flooding that submerged the grain crops.
translations.idiomatic: Rain and flooding submerged the grain crops in Dingtao and Wuqing counties of Caozhou, in Puzhou, and in Tangyi County.

sentences.zh: 十二月，冠州、永年縣水。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, Guanzhou and Yongnian County suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Guanzhou and Yongnian County were flooded.

sentences.zh: 十六年十二月，保定等路水。

translations.literal: Year 16, twelfth month, Baoding and other circuits suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the sixteenth year, Baoding and other circuits were flooded.

sentences.zh: 十七年正月，磁州、永平縣水。

translations.literal: Year 17, first month, Cizhou and Yongping County suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the seventeenth year, Cizhou and Yongping County were flooded.

sentences.zh: 八月，大都、北京、懷孟、保定、東平、濟寧等路水。

translations.literal: Eighth month, Dadu, Beiping, Huaimeng, Baoding, Dongping, Jinan, and other circuits suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Dadu, Beiping, Huaimeng, Baoding, Dongping, Jinan, and other circuits were flooded.

sentences.zh: 十八年二月，遼陽懿州、蓋州水。

translations.literal: Year 18, second month, Liaoyang's Yizhou and Gaizhou suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the eighteenth year, Yizhou and Gaizhou in Liaoyang were flooded.

sentences.zh: 十一月，保定清苑縣水。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, Baoding's Qingyuan County suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Qingyuan County in Baoding was flooded.

sentences.zh: 二十年六月，太原、懷孟、河南等路沁河水湧溢，壞民田一千六百七十餘頃。

translations.literal: Year 20, sixth month, Taiyuan, Huaimeng, Henan, and other circuits—the Qin River surged and overflowed, destroying more than 1,670 qing of civilian fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the twentieth year, the Qin River surged and overflowed in Taiyuan, Huaimeng, Henan, and other circuits, destroying more than 1,670 qing of farmland.

sentences.zh: 衛輝路清河溢，損稼。

translations.literal: Weihui Circuit's Qing River overflowed and damaged the crops.
translations.idiomatic: The Qing River overflowed in Weihui Circuit and ruined the crops.

sentences.zh: 南陽府唐、鄧、裕、嵩四州河水溢，損稼。

translations.literal: Nanyang Prefecture's four prefectures of Tang, Deng, Yu, and Song—the rivers overflowed and damaged the crops.
translations.idiomatic: Rivers overflowed in the four prefectures of Tang, Deng, Yu, and Song under Nanyang Prefecture, ruining the crops.

sentences.zh: 十月，涿州巨馬河溢。

translations.literal: Tenth month, Zhuozhou's Juma River overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, the Juma River overflowed at Zhuozhou.

sentences.zh: 二十一年六月，保定、河間、濱、棣大水。

translations.literal: Year 21, sixth month, Baoding, Hejian, Bin, and Di suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the twenty-first year, great floods struck Baoding, Hejian, Bin, and Di.

sentences.zh: 二十二年秋，南京、彰德、大名、河間、順德、濟南等路河水壞田三千餘頃。

translations.literal: Year 22, autumn, Nanjing, Zhangde, Daming, Hejian, Shunde, Jinan, and other circuits—river water destroyed more than 3,000 qing of fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the twenty-second year, flooding destroyed more than 3,000 qing of fields in Nanjing, Zhangde, Daming, Hejian, Shunde, Jinan, and other circuits.

sentences.zh: 高郵、慶元大水，傷人民七百九十五戶，壞廬舍三千九十區。

translations.literal: Gaoyou and Qingyuan suffered great floods, harming 795 households and destroying 3,090 dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: Great floods at Gaoyou and Qingyuan affected 795 households and destroyed 3,090 dwellings.

sentences.zh: 二十三年六月，安西路華州華陰縣大雨，潼谷水湧，平地三丈餘。

translations.literal: Year 23, sixth month, Anxi Circuit's Huazhou Huayin County suffered heavy rain; the Tonggu waters surged to more than three zhang on level ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the twenty-third year, heavy rain fell on Huayin County in Huazhou, Anxi Circuit, and the Tonggu River surged to more than thirty feet on level ground.

sentences.zh: 杭州、平江二路屬縣水，壞民田一萬七千二百頃。

translations.literal: Hangzhou and Pingjiang circuits' subordinate counties suffered flooding, destroying 17,200 qing of civilian fields.
translations.idiomatic: Flooding in the counties subordinate to Hangzhou and Pingjiang circuits destroyed 17,200 qing of farmland.

sentences.zh: 大都涿、漷、檀、順、薊五州，汴梁、歸德七縣水。

translations.literal: Dadu's five prefectures of Zhuo, Huo, Tan, Shun, and Ji, and Bianliang and Guide's seven counties suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Floods struck the five prefectures of Zhuo, Huo, Tan, Shun, and Ji in the Dadu region and seven counties in Bianliang and Guide.

sentences.zh: 二十四年六月，霸州益津縣雨水。

translations.literal: Year 24, sixth month, Bazhou's Yijin County suffered rain and flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the twenty-fourth year, Yijin County in Bazhou was inundated by rain.

sentences.zh: 九月，東京義、靜、威遠、婆娑等處水。

translations.literal: Ninth month, the Eastern Capital's Yi, Jing, Weiyuan, Popo, and other places suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Yi, Jing, Weiyuan, Popo, and other districts of the Eastern Capital were flooded.

sentences.zh: 二十五年七月，膠州大水，民采橡為食。

translations.literal: Year 25, seventh month, Jiaozhou suffered a great flood; the people gathered acorns for food.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the twenty-fifth year, a great flood struck Jiaozhou, and the people gathered acorns to eat.

sentences.zh: 十二月，太原、汴梁二路河溢，害稼。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, Taiyuan and Bianliang circuits' rivers overflowed and harmed the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, rivers overflowed in Taiyuan and Bianliang circuits and ruined the crops.

sentences.zh: 二十六年二月，紹興大水。

translations.literal: Year 26, second month, Shaoxing suffered a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the twenty-sixth year, Shaoxing was inundated.

sentences.zh: 十月，平灤路水，壞田稼一千一百頃。

translations.literal: Tenth month, Pingluan Circuit suffered flooding, destroying 1,100 qing of fields and crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, flooding in Pingluan Circuit destroyed 1,100 qing of fields and crops.

sentences.zh: 二十七年正月，甘州、無為路大水。

translations.literal: Year 27, first month, Ganzhou and Wuwei Circuit suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twenty-seventh year, great floods struck Ganzhou and Wuwei Circuit.

sentences.zh: 五月，江陰州大水。

translations.literal: Fifth month, Jiangyin Prefecture suffered a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Jiangyin Prefecture was inundated.

sentences.zh: 六月，河溢太康縣，沒民田三十一萬九千畝。

translations.literal: Sixth month, the river overflowed at Taikang County, submerging 319,000 mu of civilian fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, the Yellow River overflowed at Taikang County and submerged 319,000 mu of farmland.

sentences.zh: 八月，沁水溢。

translations.literal: Eighth month, the Qin River overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, the Qin River overflowed.

sentences.zh: 廣州清遠縣大水。

translations.literal: Guangzhou's Qingyuan County suffered a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: Qingyuan County in Guangzhou was inundated.

sentences.zh: 十一月，河決祥符義唐灣，太康、通許二縣，陳、潁二州，大被其患。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, the river burst at Xiangfu's Yitang Bay; Taikang and Tongxu counties and Chen and Ying prefectures suffered greatly from the disaster.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, the Yellow River burst its banks at Yitang Bay in Xiangfu. Taikang and Tongxu counties and the prefectures of Chen and Ying were devastated.

sentences.zh: 二十八年二月，常德路水。

translations.literal: Year 28, second month, Changde Circuit suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the twenty-eighth year, Changde Circuit was flooded.

sentences.zh: 八月，浙東婺州水。

translations.literal: Eighth month, eastern Zhejiang's Wuzhou suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Wuzhou in eastern Zhejiang was flooded.

sentences.zh: 九月，平灤、保定、河間三路大水。

translations.literal: Ninth month, Pingluan, Baoding, and Hejian circuits suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, great floods struck the three circuits of Pingluan, Baoding, and Hejian.

sentences.zh: 二十九年五月，龍興路南昌、新建、進賢三縣水。

translations.literal: Year 29, fifth month, Longxing Circuit's Nanchang, Xinjian, and Jinxian counties suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the twenty-ninth year, Nanchang, Xinjian, and Jinxian counties in Longxing Circuit were flooded.

sentences.zh: 六月，鎮江、常州、平江、嘉興、湖州、松江、紹興等路府水。

translations.literal: Sixth month, Zhenjiang, Changzhou, Pingjiang, Jiaxing, Huzhou, Songjiang, Shaoxing, and other circuits and prefectures suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, flooding struck Zhenjiang, Changzhou, Pingjiang, Jiaxing, Huzhou, Songjiang, Shaoxing, and other circuits and prefectures.

sentences.zh: 揚州、寧國、太平三郡大水。

translations.literal: Yangzhou, Ningguo, and Taiping commanderies suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: Great floods struck the three commanderies of Yangzhou, Ningguo, and Taiping.

sentences.zh: 岳州華容縣水。

translations.literal: Yuezhou's Huarong County suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Huarong County in Yuezhou was flooded.

sentences.zh: 三十年五月，深州靜安縣大水。

translations.literal: Year 30, fifth month, Shenzhou's Jing'an County suffered a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the thirtieth year, Jing'an County in Shenzhou was inundated.

sentences.zh: 十月，平灤路水。

translations.literal: Tenth month, Pingluan Circuit suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Pingluan Circuit was flooded.

sentences.zh: 三十一年八月，趙州寧晉縣水。

translations.literal: Year 31, eighth month, Zhaozhou's Ningjin County suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the thirty-first year, Ningjin County in Zhaozhou was flooded.

sentences.zh: 十月，遼陽路水。

translations.literal: Tenth month, Liaoyang Circuit suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Liaoyang Circuit was flooded.

sentences.zh: 元貞元年五月，建康溧陽州，太平當塗縣，鎮江金檀、丹徒等縣，常州無錫州，平江長洲縣，湖州烏程縣，鄱陽余幹州，常德沅江、澧州安鄉等縣水。

translations.literal: Yuanzhen year 1, fifth month, Jiankang's Liyang Prefecture, Taiping's Dangtu County, Zhenjiang's Jintan and Dantu counties, Changzhou's Wuxi Prefecture, Pingjiang's Changzhou County, Huzhou's Wucheng County, Poyang's Yugan Prefecture, Changde's Yuanjiang and Lizhou's Anxiang counties suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the first year of the Yuanzhen reign period, flooding struck Liyang Prefecture in Jiankang, Dangtu County in Taiping, Jintan and Dantu counties in Zhenjiang, Wuxi Prefecture in Changzhou, Changzhou County in Pingjiang, Wucheng County in Huzhou, Yugan Prefecture in Poyang, Yuanjiang in Changde, and Anxiang County in Lizhou.

sentences.zh: 六月，泰安州奉符、曹州濟陰、兗州嵫陽等縣水。

translations.literal: Sixth month, Tai'an Prefecture's Fengfu, Caozhou's Jiyin, Yanzhou's Ziyang, and other counties suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Fengfu in Tai'an Prefecture, Jiyin in Caozhou, Ziyang in Yanzhou, and other counties were flooded.

sentences.zh: 歷城縣大清河水溢，壞民居。

translations.literal: Licheng County's Daqing River overflowed and destroyed civilian dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: The Daqing River overflowed at Licheng County and destroyed civilian dwellings.

sentences.zh: 七月，遼東和州、大都武衛屯田水。

translations.literal: Seventh month, Liaodong's Hezhou and Dadu's Wuwei military colony fields suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Hezhou in Liaodong and the Wuwei military colony fields in Dadu were flooded.

sentences.zh: 九月，廬州、平江二郡大水。

translations.literal: Ninth month, Luzhou and Pingjiang commanderies suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, great floods struck the commanderies of Luzhou and Pingjiang.

sentences.zh: 二年五月，太原平晉縣，獻州交河、樂壽二縣，莫州任丘、莫亭等縣，湖南醴陵州水。

translations.literal: Year 2, fifth month, Taiyuan's Pingjin County, Xianzhou's Jiaohe and Leshou counties, Mozhou's Renqiu and Moting counties, Hunan's Liling Prefecture suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the second year, flooding struck Pingjin County in Taiyuan, Jiaohe and Leshou counties in Xianzhou, Renqiu and Moting counties in Mozhou, and Liling Prefecture in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 六月，大都路益津、保定、大興三縣水，損田稼七千餘頃。

translations.literal: Sixth month, Dadu Circuit's Yijin, Baoding, and Daxing counties suffered flooding, damaging more than 7,000 qing of fields and crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Yijin, Baoding, and Daxing counties in Dadu Circuit were flooded, destroying more than 7,000 qing of fields and crops.

sentences.zh: 真定鼓城、獲鹿、槁城等縣，保定葛城、歸信、新安、束鹿等縣，汝寧潁州，濟寧沛縣，揚、廬、嶽、澧四郡，建康、太平、鎮江、常州、紹興五郡水。

translations.literal: Zhending's Gucheng, Huolu, Gaocheng, and other counties; Baoding's Gecheng, Guixin, Xin'an, Shulu, and other counties; Runing's Yingzhou; Jining's Pei County; Yang, Lu, Yue, and Li four commanderies; Jiankang, Taiping, Zhenjiang, Changzhou, and Shaoxing five commanderies suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Flooding struck Gucheng, Huolu, Gaocheng, and other counties in Zhending; Gecheng, Guixin, Xin'an, Shulu, and other counties in Baoding; Yingzhou in Runing; Pei County in Jining; the four commanderies of Yang, Lu, Yue, and Li; and the five commanderies of Jiankang, Taiping, Zhenjiang, Changzhou, and Shaoxing.

sentences.zh: 八月，棣州、曹州水。

translations.literal: Eighth month, Dizhou and Caozhou suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Dizhou and Caozhou were flooded.

sentences.zh: 九月，河決河南杞、封丘、祥符、寧陵、襄邑五縣。

translations.literal: Ninth month, the river burst in Henan's Qi, Fengqiu, Xiangfu, Ningling, and Xiangyi counties.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, the Yellow River burst its banks in the five counties of Qi, Fengqiu, Xiangfu, Ningling, and Xiangyi in Henan.

sentences.zh: 十月，河決開封縣。

translations.literal: Tenth month, the river burst at Kaifeng County.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, the Yellow River burst its banks at Kaifeng County.

sentences.zh: 十二月，江陵潛江縣，沔陽玉沙縣，淮安海寧朐山、鹽城等縣水。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, Jiangling's Qianjiang County, Mianyang's Yusha County, Huai'an's Haining Qushan, Yancheng, and other counties suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Qianjiang County in Jiangling, Yusha County in Mianyang, and Qushan, Yancheng, and other counties in Haining, Huai'an, were flooded.

sentences.zh: 大德元年三月，歸德徐州，邳州宿遷、睢寧，鹿邑三縣，河南許州臨潁、郾城等縣，睢州襄邑，太康、扶溝、陳留、開封、杞等縣，河水大溢，漂沒田廬。

translations.literal: Dade year 1, third month, Guide's Xuzhou, Pizhou's Suqian and Suining, Luyi's three counties, Henan's Xuzhou Linying, Yancheng, and other counties, Suizhou's Xiangyi, Taikang, Fugou, Chenliu, Kaifeng, Qi, and other counties—the river greatly overflowed, sweeping away fields and dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the first year of the Dade reign period, the rivers overflowed greatly at Xuzhou in Guide, Suqian and Suining in Pizhou, the three counties of Luyi, Linying and Yancheng in Xuzhou, Henan, Xiangyi in Suizhou, and Taikang, Fugou, Chenliu, Kaifeng, Qi, and other counties, sweeping away fields and dwellings.

sentences.zh: 五月，河決汴梁，發民夫三萬五千塞之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, the river burst at Bianliang; 35,000 corvée laborers were mobilized to block it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, the Yellow River burst its banks at Bianliang, and 35,000 corvée laborers were mobilized to seal the breach.

sentences.zh: 漳水溢，害稼。

translations.literal: The Zhang River overflowed and harmed the crops.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhang River overflowed and ruined the crops.

sentences.zh: 龍興、南康、澧州、南雄、饒州五郡水。

translations.literal: Longxing, Nankang, Lizhou, Nanxiong, and Raozhou five commanderies suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Flooding struck the five commanderies of Longxing, Nankang, Lizhou, Nanxiong, and Raozhou.

sentences.zh: 六月，和州歷陽縣江水溢，漂廬舍一萬八千五百區。

translations.literal: Sixth month, Hezhou's Liyang County—the Yangzi River overflowed, sweeping away 18,500 dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, the Yangzi River overflowed at Liyang County in Hezhou, sweeping away 18,500 dwellings.

sentences.zh: 七月，郴州耒陽縣、衡州酃縣大水，溺死三百餘人。

translations.literal: Seventh month, Chenzhou's Leiyang County and Hengzhou's Ling County suffered great floods; more than 300 people drowned.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, great floods at Leiyang County in Chenzhou and Ling County in Hengzhou drowned more than three hundred people.

sentences.zh: 九月，溫州平陽、瑞安二州水，溺死六千八百餘人。

translations.literal: Ninth month, Wenzhou's Pingyang and Ruian prefectures suffered flooding; more than 6,800 people drowned.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, flooding at Pingyang and Ruian prefectures in Wenzhou drowned more than 6,800 people.

sentences.zh: 十一月，常德武陵縣大水。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, Changde's Wuling County suffered a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Wuling County in Changde was inundated.

sentences.zh: 二年六月，河決蒲口，凡九十六所，泛溢汴梁、歸德二郡。

translations.literal: Year 2, sixth month, the river burst at Pukou—in all ninety-six places—and flooded Bianliang and Guide commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the second year, the Yellow River burst at Pukou in ninety-six places and inundated the commanderies of Bianliang and Guide.

sentences.zh: 大名、東昌、平灤等路水。

translations.literal: Daming, Dongchang, Pingluan, and other circuits suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Flooding struck Daming, Dongchang, Pingluan, and other circuits.

sentences.zh: 三年八月，河間郡水。

translations.literal: Year 3, eighth month, Hejian Commandery suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the third year, Hejian Commandery was flooded.

sentences.zh: 四年五月，保定、真定二郡，通、薊二州水。

translations.literal: Year 4, fifth month, Baoding and Zhending two commanderies, Tong and Ji two prefectures suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fourth year, Baoding and Zhending commanderies and Tong and Ji prefectures were flooded.

sentences.zh: 六月，歸德睢州大水。

translations.literal: Sixth month, Guide's Suizhou suffered a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Suizhou in Guide was inundated.

sentences.zh: 五年五月，宣德、保定、河間屬州水。

translations.literal: Year 5, fifth month, Xuande, Baoding, and Hejian subordinate prefectures suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fifth year, the subordinate prefectures of Xuande, Baoding, and Hejian were flooded.

sentences.zh: 寧海州水。

translations.literal: Ninghai Prefecture suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Ninghai Prefecture was flooded.

sentences.zh: 六月，濟寧、般陽、益都、東平、濟南、襄陽、平江七郡水。

translations.literal: Sixth month, Jining, Panyang, Yidu, Dongping, Jinan, Xiangyang, and Pingjiang seven commanderies suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, the seven commanderies of Jining, Panyang, Yidu, Dongping, Jinan, Xiangyang, and Pingjiang were flooded.

sentences.zh: 七月，江水暴風大溢，高四五丈，連崇明、通、泰、真州定江之地，漂沒廬舍，被災者三萬四千八百餘戶。

translations.literal: Seventh month, the river water surged greatly in storm winds, rising four or five zhang; continuously through Chongming, Tong, Tai, and Zhenzhou Dingjiang lands, dwellings were swept away; those affected numbered more than 34,800 households.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, storm winds drove the river to surge more than forty feet high, inundating the lands of Chongming, Tongzhou, Taizhou, and Dingjiang in Zhenzhou; dwellings were swept away, and more than 34,800 households were affected.

sentences.zh: 遼陽大寧路水。

translations.literal: Liaoyang Daning Circuit suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Flooding struck Liaoyang Daning Circuit.

sentences.zh: 八月，平灤郡雨，灤河溢。

translations.literal: Eighth month, Pingluan Commandery rained; the Luan River overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, heavy rains fell on Pingluan Commandery, and the Luan River overflowed.

sentences.zh: 順德路水。

translations.literal: Shunde Circuit suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Shunde Circuit was flooded.

sentences.zh: 六年四月，上都大水。

translations.literal: Year 6, fourth month, Shangdu suffered a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the sixth year, Shangdu was inundated.

sentences.zh: 五月，濟南路大水。

translations.literal: Fifth month, Jinan Circuit suffered a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Jinan Circuit was inundated.

sentences.zh: 歸德府徐州、邳州睢寧縣雨五十日，沂、武二河合流，大水溢。

translations.literal: Guide Prefecture's Xuzhou, Pizhou's Suining County—rain for fifty days; the Yi and Wu two rivers joined their flow, and great floodwaters overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: At Xuzhou in Guide Prefecture and Suining County in Pizhou, rain fell for fifty days; the Yi and Wu Rivers merged and overflowed in a catastrophic flood.

sentences.zh: 東安州渾河溢，壞民田一千八十餘頃。

translations.literal: Dong'an Prefecture—the Hun River overflowed, damaging more than 1,080 qing of civilian fields.
translations.idiomatic: The Hun River overflowed at Dong'an Prefecture, destroying more than 1,080 qing of farmland.

sentences.zh: 六月，廣平路大水。

translations.literal: Sixth month, Guangping Circuit suffered a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Guangping Circuit was inundated.

sentences.zh: 七年五月，濟南、河間等路水。

translations.literal: Year 7, fifth month, Jinan, Hejian, and other circuits suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the seventh year, Jinan, Hejian, and other circuits were flooded.

sentences.zh: 六月，遼陽、大寧、平灤、昌國、沈陽、開元六郡雨水，壞田廬，男女死者百十有九人。

translations.literal: Sixth month, Liaoyang, Daning, Pingluan, Changguo, Shenyang, and Kaiyuan six commanderies suffered rain flooding; fields and dwellings were damaged; men and women who died numbered 119 persons.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, rain flooding struck the six commanderies of Liaoyang, Daning, Pingluan, Changguo, Shenyang, and Kaiyuan, destroying fields and dwellings; 119 men and women perished.

sentences.zh: 修武、河陽、新野、蘭陽等縣趙河、湍河、白河、七里河、沁河、潦河皆溢。

translations.literal: Xiuwu, Heyang, Xinye, Lanyang, and other counties—the Zhao River, Tuan River, Bai River, Qili River, Qin River, and Lao River all overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: In Xiuwu, Heyang, Xinye, Lanyang, and other counties, the Zhao, Tuan, Bai, Qili, Qin, and Lao Rivers all overflowed.

sentences.zh: 臺州風水大作，寧海、臨海二縣死者五百五十人。

translations.literal: Taizhou—a great wind-and-water disaster arose; Ninghai and Linhai two counties—550 persons died.
translations.idiomatic: A violent storm and flood struck Taizhou; 550 people perished in Ninghai and Linhai counties.

sentences.zh: 八年五月，太原陽武縣、衛輝獲嘉縣、汴梁祥符縣河溢。

translations.literal: Year 8, fifth month, Taiyuan's Yangwu County, Weihui's Huojia County, and Bianliang's Xiangfu County—the river overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the eighth year, the Yellow River overflowed at Yangwu County in Taiyuan, Huojia County in Weihui, and Xiangfu County in Bianliang.

sentences.zh: 大名滑州、濬州雨水，壞民田六百八十餘頃。

translations.literal: Daming's Huazhou and Xunzhou suffered rain flooding, damaging more than 680 qing of civilian fields.
translations.idiomatic: Heavy rains flooded Huazhou and Xunzhou in Daming, destroying more than 680 qing of farmland.

sentences.zh: 八月，潮陽颶風海溢，漂民廬舍。

translations.literal: Eighth month, Chaoyang—a hurricane; the sea overflowed, sweeping away civilian dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, a hurricane drove the sea inland at Chaoyang, sweeping away dwellings.

sentences.zh: 九年六月，汴梁陽武縣思齊口河決。

translations.literal: Year 9, sixth month, Bianliang's Yangwu County at Siqi Mouth—the river burst.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the ninth year, the Yellow River burst its banks at Siqi Mouth in Yangwu County, Bianliang.

sentences.zh: 東昌博平、堂邑二縣雨水。

translations.literal: Dongchang's Boping and Tangyi two counties suffered rain flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Heavy rains flooded Boping and Tangyi counties in Dongchang.

sentences.zh: 潼川郪縣雨，綿江、中江溢，水決入城。

translations.literal: Tongchuan's Qi County rained; the Mian River and Zhong River overflowed; water burst into the city.
translations.idiomatic: Rain at Qi County in Tongchuan caused the Mian and Zhong Rivers to overflow and flood the city.

sentences.zh: 龍興、撫州、臨川三郡水。

translations.literal: Longxing, Fuzhou, and Linchuan three commanderies suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Flooding struck the three commanderies of Longxing, Fuzhou, and Linchuan.

sentences.zh: 七月，沔陽玉沙縣江溢。

translations.literal: Seventh month, Mianyang's Yusha County—the river overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, the river overflowed at Yusha County in Mianyang.

sentences.zh: 嶧州水。

translations.literal: Yizhou suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhou was flooded.

sentences.zh: 揚州泰興縣，淮安山陽縣水。

translations.literal: Yangzhou's Taixing County and Huai'an's Shanyang County suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Taixing County in Yangzhou and Shanyang County in Huai'an were flooded.

sentences.zh: 八月，歸德府寧陵，陳留、通許、扶溝、太康、杞縣河溢。

translations.literal: Eighth month, Guide Prefecture's Ningling, Chenliu, Tongxu, Fugou, Taikang, and Qi counties—the river overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, the Yellow River overflowed at Ningling in Guide Prefecture and Chenliu, Tongxu, Fugou, Taikang, and Qi counties.

sentences.zh: 大名元城縣大水。

translations.literal: Daming's Yuancheng County suffered a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: Yuancheng County in Daming was inundated.

sentences.zh: 十年五月，雄州、漷州水。

translations.literal: Year 10, fifth month, Xiongzhou and Huozhou suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the tenth year, Xiongzhou and Huozhou were flooded.

sentences.zh: 平江、嘉興二郡水，害稼。

translations.literal: Pingjiang and Jiaxing two commanderies suffered flooding, harming the crops.
translations.idiomatic: Flooding at Pingjiang and Jiaxing commanderies ruined the crops.

sentences.zh: 六月，保定滿城、清苑二縣雨水。

translations.literal: Sixth month, Baoding's Mancheng and Qingyuan two counties suffered rain flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, heavy rains flooded Mancheng and Qingyuan counties in Baoding.

sentences.zh: 大名、益都、定興等路大水。

translations.literal: Daming, Yidu, Dingxing, and other circuits suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: Major flooding struck Daming, Yidu, Dingxing, and other circuits.

sentences.zh: 七月，平江路大風，海溢。

translations.literal: Seventh month, Pingjiang Circuit—a great wind; the sea overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, a great gale drove the sea inland at Pingjiang Circuit.

sentences.zh: 吳江州大水。

translations.literal: Wujiang Prefecture suffered a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: Wujiang Prefecture was inundated.

sentences.zh: 十一年六月，靖海、容城、束鹿、隆平、新城等縣水。

translations.literal: Year 11, sixth month, Jinghai, Rongcheng, Shulu, Longping, Xincheng, and other counties suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the eleventh year, Jinghai, Rongcheng, Shulu, Longping, Xincheng, and other counties were flooded.

sentences.zh: 七月，冀寧文水縣汾水溢。

translations.literal: Seventh month, Ji'ning Circuit's Wenshui County—the Fen River overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, the Fen River overflowed at Wenshui County in Ji'ning Circuit.

sentences.zh: 十一月，盧龍、灤河、遷安、昌黎、撫寧等縣水。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, Lulong, Luanhe, Qian'an, Changli, Funing, and other counties suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Lulong, Luanhe, Qian'an, Changli, Funing, and other counties were flooded.

sentences.zh: 延祐元年五月，常德路武陵縣雨水，壞廬舍，溺死者五百人。

translations.literal: Yanyou year 1, fifth month, Changde Circuit's Wuling County suffered rain flooding, damaging dwellings; drowned dead numbered 500 persons.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the first year of the Yanyou reign period, heavy rains at Wuling County in Changde Circuit destroyed dwellings and drowned 500 people.

sentences.zh: 六月，涿州范陽、房山二縣渾河溢，壞民田四百九十餘頃。

translations.literal: Sixth month, Zhuozhou's Fanyang and Fangshan two counties—the Hun River overflowed, damaging more than 490 qing of civilian fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, the Hun River overflowed at Fanyang and Fangshan counties in Zhuozhou, destroying more than 490 qing of farmland.

sentences.zh: 七月，沅陵、盧溪二縣水。

translations.literal: Seventh month, Yuanling and Luxi two counties suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Yuanling and Luxi counties were flooded.

sentences.zh: 八月，肇慶、武昌、建康、杭州、建德、南康、江州、臨江、袁州、建昌、贛州、安豐、撫州等路水。

translations.literal: Eighth month, Zhaoqing, Wuchang, Jiankang, Hangzhou, Jiande, Nankang, Jiangzhou, Linjiang, Yuanzhou, Jianchang, Ganzhou, Anfeng, Fuzhou, and other circuits suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Zhaoqing, Wuchang, Jiankang, Hangzhou, Jiande, Nankang, Jiangzhou, Linjiang, Yuanzhou, Jianchang, Ganzhou, Anfeng, Fuzhou, and other circuits were flooded.

sentences.zh: 二年六月，河決鄭州，壞汜水縣治。

translations.literal: Year 2, sixth month, the river burst at Zhengzhou, destroying Sishui County's seat of government.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the second year, the Yellow River burst its banks at Zhengzhou and destroyed the county seat of Sishui.

sentences.zh: 七月，京師大雨。

sentences.zh: 九月，平遙縣汾水溢。

translations.literal: Ninth month, Pingyao County—the Fen River overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, the Fen River overflowed at Pingyao County.

sentences.zh: 十一月，崇明州三沙鎮海溢，漂民居五百家。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, Chongming Prefecture's Sansha Town—sea overflow; swept away five hundred civilian dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, the sea surged at Sansha Town in Chongming Prefecture, washing away five hundred dwellings.

sentences.zh: 十二月，遼陽大水。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, Liaoyang—great flood.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Liaoyang was inundated.

sentences.zh: 大寧路瑞州大水，壞民田五千五百頃，廬舍八百九十所，溺死者百五十人。

translations.literal: Daining Circuit's Ruizhou—great flood; destroyed 5,500 qing of civilian fields, 890 dwellings; drowned dead numbered 150 persons.
translations.idiomatic: A great flood at Ruizhou in Daining Circuit destroyed 5,500 qing of farmland and 890 dwellings; 150 people drowned.

sentences.zh: 四年正月，鹽官州潮水大溢，捍海堤崩二千餘步。

translations.literal: Year 4, first month, Yanguan Prefecture—tide water greatly overflowed; sea-defense dike collapsed more than 2,000 paces.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year of the Taiding reign period, the tide surged at Yanguan Prefecture, breaching more than 2,000 paces of the sea-defense dike.

sentences.zh: 四月，復崩十九里，發丁夫二萬餘人，以木柵竹落磚石塞之，不止。

translations.literal: Fourth month, collapsed again for nineteen li; mobilized more than 20,000 corvée laborers; used timber palisades, bamboo cages, and brick and stone to stop it—not stopped.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, the dike collapsed again across nineteen li; more than twenty thousand corvée laborers were conscripted to plug the breach with timber palisades, bamboo cages, and masonry, but the sea would not be contained.

sentences.zh: 六月，大都東安、固安、通、順、薊、檀、漷七州，永清、良鄉等縣雨水。

translations.literal: Sixth month, Dadu—Dong'an, Gu'an, Tong, Shun, Ji, Tan, Huo seven prefectures; Yongqing, Liangxiang, and other counties—rain flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, rain flooding struck the seven prefectures of Dong'an, Gu'an, Tong, Shun, Ji, Tan, and Huo in Dadu and Yongqing, Liangxiang, and other counties.

sentences.zh: 七月，上都雲州大雨。

translations.literal: Seventh month, Shangdu's Yunzhou—great rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, heavy rains fell on Yunzhou at Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 北山黑水河溢。

translations.literal: Beishan—the Heishui River overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: The Heishui River overflowed at Beishan.

sentences.zh: 雲安縣水。

translations.literal: Yun'an County—flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Yun'an County was flooded.

sentences.zh: 八月，汴梁扶溝、蘭陽二縣河溢，漂民居一千九百餘家。

translations.literal: Eighth month, Bianliang's Fugou and Lanyang two counties—the river overflowed; swept away more than 1,900 civilian dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, the Yellow River overflowed at Fugou and Lanyang counties in Bianliang, washing away more than 1,900 dwellings.

sentences.zh: 濟寧虞城縣河溢，傷稼。

translations.literal: Jining's Yucheng County—the river overflowed; crops damaged.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River overflowed at Yucheng County in Jining, ruining the crops.

sentences.zh: 十二月，夏邑縣河溢。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, Xiayi County—the river overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, the Yellow River overflowed at Xiayi County.

sentences.zh: 汴梁中牟、開封、陳留三縣，歸德邳、宿二州雨水。

translations.literal: Bianliang's Zhongmou, Kaifeng, Chenliu three counties; Guide's Pi and Su two prefectures—rain flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongmou, Kaifeng, and Chenliu counties in Bianliang and Pi and Su prefectures in Guide were inundated by rain.

sentences.zh: 致和元年三月，鹽官州海堤崩，遣使禱祀，造浮圖二百十六，用西僧法壓之。

translations.literal: Zhihe year 1, third month, Yanguan Prefecture—sea dike collapsed; dispatched envoys to pray and offer sacrifice; built 216 stupas; used Western monks' methods to suppress it.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the first year of the Zhihe reign period, the sea dike collapsed at Yanguan Prefecture; envoys were dispatched to perform rites of prayer and sacrifice, two hundred sixteen stupas were erected, and Tibetan Buddhist rites were performed to subdue the waters.

sentences.zh: 河決碭山、虞城二縣。

translations.literal: The river burst at Dangshan and Yucheng two counties.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River burst its banks at Dangshan and Yucheng counties.

sentences.zh: 四月，鹽官州海溢，益發軍民塞之，置石囤二十九里。

translations.literal: Fourth month, Yanguan Prefecture—sea overflow; further mobilized soldiers and civilians to stop it; placed stone cribs for twenty-nine li.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, the sea overflowed at Yanguan Prefecture; additional troops and civilians were mobilized to stem it, and stone cribs were laid along twenty-nine li of coastline.

sentences.zh: 六月，南寧、開元、永平等路水。

translations.literal: Sixth month, Nanning, Kaiyuan, Yongping, and other circuits—flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Nanning, Kaiyuan, Yongping, and other circuits were flooded.

sentences.zh: 河間臨邑縣雨水。

translations.literal: Hejian's Linyi County—rain flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Linyi County in Hejian was inundated by rain.

sentences.zh: 益都、濟南、般陽、濟寧、東平等郡三十縣，濮、德、泰安等州九縣雨水害稼。

translations.literal: Yidu, Jinan, Panyang, Jining, Dongping, and other commanderies—thirty counties; Pu, De, Tai'an, and other prefectures—nine counties—rain flooding harmed crops.
translations.idiomatic: Heavy rains ruined the crops in thirty counties across the commanderies of Yidu, Jinan, Panyang, Jining, and Dongping and nine counties in the prefectures of Pu, De, and Tai'an.

sentences.zh: 七月，廣西兩江諸州水。

translations.literal: Seventh month, Guangxi's Liangjiang various prefectures—flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, prefectures throughout the Two Rivers region of Guangxi were flooded.

sentences.zh: 天歷元年八月，杭州、嘉興、平江、湖州、建德、鎮江、池州、太平、廣德九郡水，沒民田萬四千餘頃。

translations.literal: Tianli year 1, eighth month, Hangzhou, Jiaxing, Pingjiang, Huzhou, Jiande, Zhenjiang, Chizhou, Taiping, Guangde nine commanderies—flooding; submerged more than 14,000 qing of civilian fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the first year of the Tianli reign period, flooding in the nine commanderies of Hangzhou, Jiaxing, Pingjiang, Huzhou, Jiande, Zhenjiang, Chizhou, Taiping, and Guangde drowned more than 14,000 qing of farmland.

sentences.zh: 二年六月，大都東安、通、薊、霸四州，河間靖海縣雨水害稼。

translations.literal: Year 2, sixth month, Dadu's Dong'an, Tong, Ji, Ba four prefectures; Hejian's Jinghai County—rain flooding harmed crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the second year of the Tianli reign period, heavy rains in the four prefectures of Dong'an, Tong, Ji, and Ba in Dadu and Jinghai County in Hejian ruined the crops.

sentences.zh: 永平昌國諸屯水。

translations.literal: Yongping's Changguo various military colonies—flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Military colonies in Changguo, Yongping, were flooded.

sentences.zh: 七月，海潮溢，漂沒河間運司鹽二萬六千七百引。

translations.literal: Seventh month—sea tide overflowed; swept away 26,700 yin of salt of Hejian Transport Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the first year of the Zhishun reign period, the tide surged inland and washed away 26,700 yin of salt belonging to the Hejian transport office.

sentences.zh: 閏七月，平江、嘉興、湖州、松江三路一州大水，壞民田三萬六千六百餘頃，被災者四十萬五千五百餘戶。

translations.literal: Intercalary seventh month, Pingjiang, Jiaxing, Huzhou, Songjiang three circuits one prefecture—great flood; destroyed more than 36,600 qing of civilian fields; those affected numbered more than 405,500 households.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary seventh month, a great flood struck the circuits of Pingjiang, Jiaxing, Huzhou, and Songjiang and one prefecture, destroying more than 36,600 qing of farmland and affecting more than 405,500 households.

sentences.zh: 杭州、常州、慶元、紹興、鎮江、寧國等路，望江、銅陵、長林、寶應、興化等縣水，沒民田一萬三千五百餘頃。

translations.literal: Hangzhou, Changzhou, Qingyuan, Shaoxing, Zhenjiang, Ningguo, and other circuits; Wangjiang, Tongling, Changlin, Baoying, Xinghua, and other counties—flooding; submerged more than 13,500 qing of civilian fields.
translations.idiomatic: Flooding in the circuits of Hangzhou, Changzhou, Qingyuan, Shaoxing, Zhenjiang, and Ningguo and in Wangjiang, Tongling, Changlin, Baoying, Xinghua, and other counties drowned more than 13,500 qing of farmland.

sentences.zh: 大都、保定、大寧、益都屬州縣水。

translations.literal: Dadu, Baoding, Daining, Yidu subordinate prefectures and counties—flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinate prefectures and counties of Dadu, Baoding, Daining, and Yidu were flooded.

sentences.zh: 二年四月，潞州潞城縣大雨水。

translations.literal: Year 2, fourth month, Luzhou's Lucheng County—great rain flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the second year of the Zhishun reign period, torrential rains inundated Lucheng County in Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 五月，河間莫亭縣、寧夏河渠縣、紹慶彭水縣及德安屯田水。

translations.literal: Fifth month, Hejian's Moting County, Ningxia's Hequ County, Shaoqing's Pengshui County, and De'an military colony fields—flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Moting County in Hejian, Hequ County in Ningxia, Pengshui County in Shaoqing, and military colony lands in De'an were flooded.

sentences.zh: 六月，彰德屬縣漳水決。

translations.literal: Sixth month, Zhangde subordinate counties—the Zhang River burst its banks.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, the Zhang River burst its banks in counties under Zhangde.

sentences.zh: 十月，吳江州大風，太湖水溢，漂民居一千九百七十餘家。

translations.literal: Tenth month, Wujiang Prefecture—great wind; Tai Lake water overflowed; swept away more than 1,970 civilian dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, fierce winds at Wujiang Prefecture drove Tai Lake over its banks, washing away more than 1,970 dwellings.

sentences.zh: 十二月，深州、晉州水。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, Shenzhou, Jinzhou—flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Shenzhou and Jinzhou were flooded.

sentences.zh: 三年三月，奉元朝邑縣洛水溢。

translations.literal: Year 3, third month, Fengyuan's Chaoyi County—the Luo River overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the third year of the Zhishun reign period, the Luo River overflowed at Chaoyi County in Fengyuan.

sentences.zh: 五月，汴梁河水溢。

translations.literal: Fifth month, Bianliang—the river water overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, the Yellow River overflowed in Bianliang.

sentences.zh: 江都、泰興、雲夢、應城等縣水。

translations.literal: Jiangdu, Taixing, Yunmeng, Yingcheng, and other counties—flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangdu, Taixing, Yunmeng, Yingcheng, and other counties were flooded.

sentences.zh: 六月，汾州大水。

translations.literal: Sixth month, Fenzhou—great flood.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Fenzhou was inundated.

sentences.zh: 至元十四年九月，湖州長興縣金沙泉，自唐、宋以來，用以造茶，其泉不常有，今瀵然湧出，溉田可數百頃。

translations.literal: Zhiyuan year 14, ninth month, Huzhou's Changxing County—Jinsha Spring; since Tang and Song used to make tea; the spring was not constant; now gushed forth suddenly; irrigating fields could amount to several hundred qing.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the fourteenth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, the Jinsha Spring at Changxing County in Huzhou—used for tea production since the Tang and Song dynasties but ordinarily intermittent—gushed forth abundantly, sufficient to irrigate several hundred qing of fields.

sentences.zh: 有司以聞，錫名瑞應泉。

translations.literal: Officials reported it; bestowed the name Auspicious-Response Spring.
translations.idiomatic: The local authorities reported the event, and the spring was granted the name Spring of Auspicious Response.

sentences.zh: 十五年十二月，河水清，自孟津東柏谷至汜水縣蓼子谷，上下八十餘里，澄瑩見底，數月始如故。

translations.literal: Year 15, twelfth month, the river water cleared; from Mengjin's east Baigu to Sishui County's Liaozigu, upstream and downstream more than eighty li; clear and transparent showing the bottom; several months before returning as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the fifteenth year, the Yellow River ran clear from Baigu east of Mengjin to Liaozigu in Sishui County—a stretch of more than eighty li where the water turned crystalline and the riverbed could be seen; months passed before it returned to its normal state.

sentences.zh: 元貞元年閏四月，蘭州上下三百餘里，河清三日。

translations.literal: Yuanzhen year 1, intercalary fourth month, Lanzhou upstream and downstream more than three hundred li—the river cleared for three days.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fourth month of the first year of the Yuanzhen reign period, the Yellow River ran clear for three days along a stretch of more than three hundred li at Lanzhou.

sentences.zh: 中統二年五月，西京隕霜殺禾。

translations.literal: Zhongtong year 2, fifth month, Xijing—falling frost killed grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the second year of the Zhongtong reign period, frost at Xijing killed the grain crop.

sentences.zh: 三年五月，宣德、威寧等路隕霜。

translations.literal: Year 3, fifth month, Xuande, Weining, and other circuits—falling frost.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the third year of the Zhongtong reign period, frost fell in Xuande, Weining, and other circuits.

sentences.zh: 八月，河間、平灤等路隕霜害稼。

translations.literal: Eighth month, Hejian, Pingluan, and other circuits—falling frost harmed crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, frost in Hejian, Pingluan, and other circuits damaged the crops.

sentences.zh: 四年四月，武州隕霜殺麥禾。

translations.literal: Year 4, fourth month, Wuzhou—falling frost killed wheat and grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fourth year of the Zhongtong reign period, frost at Wuzhou killed the wheat and grain crops.

sentences.zh: 至元二年八月，太原隕霜。

translations.literal: Zhiyuan year 2, eighth month, Taiyuan—falling frost.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the second year of the Zhiyuan reign period, frost fell at Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 七年四月，檀州隕霜。

translations.literal: Year 7, fourth month, Tanzhou—falling frost.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the seventh year of the Zhiyuan reign period, frost fell at Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 八年七月，鞏昌會、蘭等州霜殺稼。

translations.literal: Year 8, seventh month, Gongchang's Hui, Lan, and other prefectures—frost killed crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the eighth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, frost in Hui, Lan, and other prefectures in Gongchang killed the crops.

sentences.zh: 十七年四月，益都隕霜。

translations.literal: Year 17, fourth month, Yidu—falling frost.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the seventeenth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, frost fell at Yidu.

sentences.zh: 二十一年三月，山東隕霜殺桑，蠶盡死，被災者三萬餘家。

translations.literal: Year 21, third month, Shandong—falling frost killed mulberry trees; silkworms all died; those affected numbered more than 30,000 families.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the twenty-first year of the Zhiyuan reign period, frost in Shandong killed the mulberry trees and silkworms alike, affecting more than thirty thousand households.

sentences.zh: 二十七年七月，大同、平陽、太原隕霜殺禾。

translations.literal: Year 27, seventh month, Datong, Pingyang, Taiyuan—falling frost killed grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the twenty-seventh year of the Zhiyuan reign period, frost at Datong, Pingyang, and Taiyuan killed the grain crop.

sentences.zh: 二十九年三月，濟南、般陽等郡及恩州屬縣霜殺桑。

translations.literal: Year 29, third month, Jinan, Panyang, and other commanderies and Enzhou subordinate counties—frost killed mulberry trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the twenty-ninth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, frost killed the mulberry trees in the commanderies of Jinan and Panyang and in counties under Enzhou.

sentences.zh: 元貞二年八月，金、復州隕霜殺禾。

translations.literal: Yuanzhen year 2, eighth month, Jin and Fu prefectures—falling frost killed grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the second year of the Yuanzhen reign period, frost at Jin and Fu prefectures killed the grain crop.

sentences.zh: 大德五年三月，湯陰縣霜殺麥。

translations.literal: Dade year 5, third month, Tangyin County—frost killed wheat.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fifth year of the Dade reign period, frost at Tangyin County killed the wheat crop.

sentences.zh: 五月，商州霜殺麥。

translations.literal: Fifth month, Shangzhou—frost killed wheat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, frost at Shangzhou killed the wheat crop.

sentences.zh: 六年八月，大同、太原霜殺禾。

translations.literal: Year 6, eighth month, Datong, Taiyuan—frost killed grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the sixth year of the Dade reign period, frost at Datong and Taiyuan killed the grain crop.

sentences.zh: 七年四月，霜殺麥。

translations.literal: Year 7, fourth month, frost killed wheat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the seventh year of the Dade reign period, frost killed the wheat crop.

sentences.zh: 八年三月，濟陽、灤城二縣霜殺桑。

translations.literal: Year 8, third month, Jiyang and Luancheng two counties—frost killed mulberry trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the eighth year of the Dade reign period, frost at Jiyang and Luancheng counties killed the mulberry trees.

sentences.zh: 八月，隕霜殺稼。

translations.literal: Eighth month, falling frost killed crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, frost killed the crops.

sentences.zh: 九年三月，河間、益都、般陽三郡屬縣隕霜殺桑。

translations.literal: Year 9, third month, Hejian, Yidu, Panyang three commanderies' subordinate counties—falling frost killed mulberry trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the ninth year of the Dade reign period, frost in counties under the commanderies of Hejian, Yidu, and Panyang killed the mulberry trees.

sentences.zh: 清、莫、滄、獻四州霜殺桑二百四十一萬七千餘本，壞蠶一萬二千七百餘箔。

translations.literal: Qing, Mo, Cang, Xian four prefectures—frost killed 2,417,000-plus mulberry trees; ruined 12,700-plus trays of silkworms.
translations.idiomatic: Frost in the four prefectures of Qing, Mo, Cang, and Xian killed more than 2,417,000 mulberry trees and destroyed more than 12,700 trays of silkworms.

sentences.zh: 十年七月，大同渾源縣霜殺禾。

translations.literal: Year 10, seventh month, Datong's Hunyuan County—frost killed grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the tenth year of the Dade reign period, frost at Hunyuan County in Datong killed the grain crop.

sentences.zh: 八月，綏德州米脂縣霜殺禾二百八十頃。

translations.literal: Eighth month, Suide Prefecture's Mizhi County—frost killed grain on 280 qing.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, frost at Mizhi County in Suide Prefecture killed the grain crop on 280 qing of land.

sentences.zh: 至大元年八月，大同隕霜殺禾。

translations.literal: Zhida year 1, eighth month, Datong—falling frost killed grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the first year of the Zhida reign period, frost at Datong killed the grain crop.

sentences.zh: 皇慶二年三月，濟寧霜殺桑。

translations.literal: Huangqing year 2, third month, Jining—frost killed mulberry trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the second year of the Huangqing reign period, frost at Jining killed the mulberry trees.

sentences.zh: 至治三年七月，冀寧陽曲縣、大同路大同縣、興和路威寧縣隕霜。

translations.literal: Zhizhi year 3, seventh month, Jining's Yangqu County, Datong Circuit's Datong County, Xinghe Circuit's Weining County—falling frost.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the third year of the Zhizhi reign period, frost fell at Yangqu County in Jining, Datong County in Datong Circuit, and Weining County in Xinghe Circuit.

sentences.zh: 八月，袁州宜春縣隕霜害稼。

translations.literal: Eighth month, Yuanzhou's Yichun County—falling frost harmed crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, frost at Yichun County in Yuanzhou damaged the crops.

sentences.zh: 泰定二年三月，雲需府大雪，民饑。

translations.literal: Taiding year 2, third month, Yunxu Prefecture—great snow; people suffered famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the second year of the Taiding reign period, heavy snow at Yunxu Prefecture left the people famished.

sentences.zh: 天歷三年二月，京師大霜，晝{矛}。

translations.literal: Tianli year 3, second month, the capital—great frost; daytime obscured.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the third year of the Tianli reign period, a heavy frost at the capital dimmed the daylight.

sentences.zh: 中統二年四月，雨雹，大如彈丸。

translations.literal: Zhongtong year 2, fourth month, rain hail—large as catapult balls.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the second year of the Zhongtong reign period, hail fell as large as sling stones.

sentences.zh: 三年五月，順天、平陽、真定、河南等郡雨雹。

translations.literal: Year 3, fifth month, Shuntian, Pingyang, Zhending, Henan, and other commanderies—rain hail.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the third year of the Zhongtong reign period, hail fell in the commanderies of Shuntian, Pingyang, Zhending, Henan, and others.

sentences.zh: 四年七月，燕京昌平縣，景州蓚縣，開平路興、松、雲三州雨雹害稼。

translations.literal: Year 4, seventh month, Yanjing's Changping County, Jing Prefecture's Tiao County, Kaiping Circuit's Xing, Song, and Yun three prefectures—rain hail harmed crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fourth year of the Zhongtong reign period, hail at Changping County in Yanjing, Tiao County in Jing Prefecture, and the three prefectures of Xing, Song, and Yun in Kaiping Circuit damaged the crops.

sentences.zh: 至元二年八月，彰德、大名、南京、河南、濟南、太原等郡雨雹。

translations.literal: Zhiyuan year 2, eighth month, Zhangde, Daming, Nanjing, Henan, Jinan, Taiyuan, and other commanderies—rain hail.
