sentences.zh: 四月，固安州王得林妻張氏懷孕五月生一男，四手四足，圓頭三耳，一耳附腦後，生而即死，具狀有司上之。

translations.literal: Fourth month, Gu'an Prefecture, Wang Delin's wife Zhang—pregnant five months, gave birth to one male; four hands and four feet, round head and three ears, one ear attached behind the brain; born and immediately died; full report submitted to the authorities.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Zhang, wife of Wang Delin of Gu'an Prefecture, after five months of pregnancy gave birth to a boy with four hands and four feet, a round head, and three ears, one attached behind the skull; he died at once upon birth. A full report was submitted to the relevant authorities.

sentences.zh: 二十八年九月，襄陽南漳縣民李氏妻王一產三子。

translations.literal: Year 28, ninth month, Xiangyang's Nanzhang County commoner Li's wife Wang—one delivery three sons.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the twenty-eighth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Wang, wife of a commoner surnamed Li of Nanzhang County in Xiangyang, gave birth to three sons at one delivery.

sentences.zh: 大德元年五月，遂寧州軍戶任福妻一產三男。

translations.literal: Dade year 1, fifth month, Suining Prefecture military household Ren Fu's wife—one delivery three boys.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the first year of the Dade reign period, the wife of Ren Fu, a military-household registrant of Suining Prefecture, gave birth to three boys at one delivery.

sentences.zh: 十一月，遼陽打雁孛蘭奚戶那懷妻和裏迷一產四男。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, Liaoyang Dayan Bolu xi household Nayihuai's wife Holimi—one delivery four boys.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Holimi, wife of Nayihuai of the Bolu xi household at Dayan in Liaoyang, gave birth to four boys at one delivery.

sentences.zh: 四年，寶應縣民孫奕妻朱氏一產三男。

translations.literal: Year 4, Baoying County commoner Sun Yi's wife Lady Zhu—one delivery three boys.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of the Dade reign period, Lady Zhu, wife of the commoner Sun Yi of Baoying County, gave birth to three boys at one delivery.

sentences.zh: 十年正月，江州湖口縣方丙妻甘氏一產四男。

translations.literal: Year 10, first month, Jiang Prefecture's Hukou County, Fang Bing's wife Lady Gan—one delivery four boys.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the tenth year of the Dade reign period, Lady Gan, wife of Fang Bing of Hukou County in Jiang Prefecture, gave birth to four boys at one delivery.

sentences.zh: 五行，二曰火。

translations.literal: Of the Five Elements, the second is Fire.
translations.idiomatic: Of the Five Elements, the second is Fire.

sentences.zh: 炎上，火之性也，失其性為沴。

translations.literal: Flaming upward—Fire's nature; when it loses its nature it becomes an aberration.
translations.idiomatic: To blaze upward is the nature of Fire; when Fire loses its nature, aberration follows.

sentences.zh: 董仲舒云：「陽失節，則火災出。

translations.literal: Dong Zhongshu said: "When yang loses its measure, then fire calamities emerge.
translations.idiomatic: Dong Zhongshu said: "When yang falls out of balance, fire disasters arise.

sentences.zh: 」於是而濫炎妄起，災宗廟，燒宮館，雖興師眾弗能救也。

translations.literal: Then wanton flames rise recklessly, calamity strikes the ancestral temples, palace halls are burned—even raising armies and masses cannot save them.
translations.idiomatic: Then flames burst forth without restraint, ancestral temples are stricken, palace halls are consumed, and even mustering armies cannot check the destruction.

sentences.zh: 是為火不炎上。

translations.literal: This is Fire not flaming upward.
translations.idiomatic: This is what is meant by Fire no longer blazing upward.

sentences.zh: 其征恒燠，其色赤，是為赤眚赤祥。

translations.literal: Its sign is constant heat, its color red—this is red calamity and red auspice.
translations.idiomatic: Its portent is unrelenting heat, its color red—these are the red calamities and red auspices.

sentences.zh: 定宗三年戊申，野草自焚，牛馬十死八九，民不聊生。

translations.literal: Emperor Dingzong year 3, on wushen day, wild grasses burned by themselves; cattle and horses nine or ten of ten died; the people could not sustain life.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Emperor Dingzong's reign, on wushen day, wild grasses burst into flame of their own accord; eight or nine out of every ten cattle and horses perished, and the people could scarcely survive.

sentences.zh: 至元十一年十二月，淮西正陽火，廬舍、鎧仗悉毀。

translations.literal: Zhiyuan year 11, twelfth month, Huai West Zhengyang—fire; dwellings and armor and weapons entirely destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the eleventh year of the Zhiyuan reign period, fire at Zhengyang in western Huai destroyed dwellings, armor, and weapons entirely.

sentences.zh: 十八年二月，揚州火。

translations.literal: Year 18, second month, Yang Prefecture—fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the eighteenth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, fire broke out at Yang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 元貞二年，杭州火，燔七百七十家。

translations.literal: Yuanzhen year 2, Hangzhou—fire; burned seven hundred seventy households.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Yuanzhen reign period, fire broke out at Hangzhou and burned seven hundred seventy households.

sentences.zh: 大德八年五月，杭州火，燔四百家。

translations.literal: Dade year 8, fifth month, Hangzhou—fire; burned four hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the eighth year of the Dade reign period, fire broke out at Hangzhou and burned four hundred households.

sentences.zh: 九年三月，宜黃縣火。

translations.literal: Year 9, third month, Yihuang County—fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the ninth year of the Dade reign period, fire broke out at Yihuang County.

sentences.zh: 十年十一月，武昌路火。

translations.literal: Year 10, eleventh month, Wuchang Circuit—fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the tenth year of the Dade reign period, fire broke out in Wuchang Circuit.

sentences.zh: 延祐元年二月，真州揚子縣火。

translations.literal: Yanyou year 1, second month, Zhen Prefecture's Yangzi County—fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the first year of the Yanyou reign period, fire broke out at Yangzi County in Zhen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 三年六月，重慶路火，郡舍十焚八九。

translations.literal: Year 3, sixth month, Chongqing Circuit—fire; of the prefectural offices, eight or nine of ten burned.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the third year of the Yanyou reign period, fire broke out in Chongqing Circuit, and eight or nine out of every ten prefectural offices were burned.

sentences.zh: 六年四月，揚州火，燔官民廬舍一萬三千三百餘區。

translations.literal: Year 6, fourth month, Yang Prefecture—fire; burned official and civilian dwellings more than thirteen thousand three hundred units.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the sixth year of the Yanyou reign period, fire broke out at Yang Prefecture and destroyed more than thirteen thousand three hundred official and private dwellings.

sentences.zh: 至治二年四月，揚州、真州火。

translations.literal: Zhizhi year 2, fourth month, Yang Prefecture and Zhen Prefecture—fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the second year of the Zhizhi reign period, fire broke out at Yang and Zhen prefectures.

sentences.zh: 十二月，杭州火。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, Hangzhou—fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the second year of the Zhizhi reign period, fire broke out at Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 三年五月，奉元路行宮正殿火，上都利用監庫火。

translations.literal: Year 3, fifth month, Fengyuan Circuit traveling palace main hall—fire; Shangdu Liyong Directorate storehouse—fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the third year of the Zhizhi reign period, fire broke out in the main hall of the traveling palace in Fengyuan Circuit, and the Liyong Directorate storehouse at Shangdu also caught fire.

sentences.zh: 九月，揚州江都縣火，燔四百七十餘家。

translations.literal: Ninth month, Yang Prefecture's Jiangdu County—fire; burned more than four hundred seventy households.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the third year of the Zhizhi reign period, fire broke out at Jiangdu County in Yang Prefecture and burned more than four hundred seventy households.

sentences.zh: 泰定元年五月，江西袁州火，燔五百餘家。

translations.literal: Taiding year 1, fifth month, Jiangxi's Yuan Prefecture—fire; burned more than five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the first year of the Taiding reign period, fire broke out at Yuan Prefecture in Jiangxi and burned more than five hundred households.

sentences.zh: 三年六月，龍興路寧州高市火，燔五百餘家。

translations.literal: Year 3, sixth month, Longxing Circuit's Ning Prefecture Gaoshi—fire; burned more than five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the third year of the Taiding reign period, fire broke out at Gaoshi in Ning Prefecture, Longxing Circuit, and burned more than five hundred households.

sentences.zh: 七月，龍興奉新縣、辰州辰溪縣火。

translations.literal: Seventh month, Longxing's Fengxin County, Chen Prefecture's Chenxi County—fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the third year of the Taiding reign period, fire broke out at Fengxin County in Longxing and Chenxi County in Chen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 八月，杭州火，燔四百七十餘家。

translations.literal: Eighth month, Hangzhou—fire; burned more than four hundred seventy households.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the third year of the Taiding reign period, fire broke out at Hangzhou and burned more than four hundred seventy households.

sentences.zh: 四年八月，龍興路火。

translations.literal: Year 4, eighth month, Longxing Circuit—fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fourth year of the Taiding reign period, fire broke out in Longxing Circuit.

sentences.zh: 十二月，杭州火，燔六百七十家。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, Hangzhou—fire; burned six hundred seventy households.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the fourth year of the Taiding reign period, fire broke out at Hangzhou and burned six hundred seventy households.

sentences.zh: 天歷二年三月，四川紹慶彭水縣火。

translations.literal: Tianli year 2, third month, Sichuan's Shaoqing Pengshui County—fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the second year of the Tianli reign period, fire broke out at Pengshui County in Shaoqing, Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 四月，重慶路火，延二百四十餘家。

translations.literal: Fourth month, Chongqing Circuit—fire; spread to more than two hundred forty households.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the second year of the Tianli reign period, fire broke out in Chongqing Circuit and spread to more than two hundred forty households.

sentences.zh: 七月，武昌路江夏縣火，延四百家。

translations.literal: Seventh month, Wuchang Circuit's Jiangxia County—fire; spread to four hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the second year of the Tianli reign period, fire broke out at Jiangxia County in Wuchang Circuit and spread to four hundred households.

sentences.zh: 十二月，江夏縣火，燔四百餘家。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, Jiangxia County—fire; burned more than four hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the second year of the Tianli reign period, fire broke out at Jiangxia County and burned more than four hundred households.

sentences.zh: 三年二月，河內諸縣火。

translations.literal: Year 3, second month, Henei various counties—fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the third year of the Tianli reign period, fire broke out in various counties of Henei.

sentences.zh: 皇慶元年，冬無雪，詔禱嶽瀆。

translations.literal: Huangqing year 1, winter without snow; an edict ordered prayer at the mountains and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Huangqing reign period, there was no snow all winter, and an edict ordered prayers at the sacred mountains and rivers.

sentences.zh: 延祐元年，大都檀、薊等州冬無雪，至春草木枯焦。

translations.literal: Yanyou year 1, the capital's Tan, Ji, and other prefectures—winter without snow; by spring grasses and trees withered and scorched.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Yanyou reign period, Tan, Ji, and other prefectures around the capital had no snow all winter, and by spring the grasses and trees were withered and scorched.

sentences.zh: 至元二年八月丙寅，濟南鄒平縣進芝一本。

translations.literal: Zhiyuan year 2, eighth month, on bingyin day, Jinan's Zouping County presented one lingzhi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day in the eighth month of the second year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Zouping County in Jinan presented one specimen of lingzhi.

sentences.zh: 八年八月癸酉，益都濟州進芝二本。

translations.literal: Year 8, eighth month, on guiyou day, Yidu's Jizhou presented two lingzhi.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day in the eighth month of the eighth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Jizhou in Yidu presented two specimens of lingzhi.

sentences.zh: 十五年四月，濟南歷城縣進芝。

translations.literal: Year 15, fourth month, Jinan's Licheng County presented lingzhi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fifteenth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Licheng County in Jinan presented lingzhi.

sentences.zh: 十九年六月，芝生眉州青神縣景德寺。

translations.literal: Year 19, sixth month, lingzhi grew at Meizhou's Qingshen County Jingde Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the nineteenth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, lingzhi appeared at Jingde Temple in Qingshen County, Meizhou.

sentences.zh: 二十三年四月丁未，江東宣慰司進芝一本。

translations.literal: Year 23, fourth month, on dingwei day, Jiangdong Pacification Commission presented one lingzhi.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day in the fourth month of the twenty-third year of the Zhiyuan reign period, the Jiangdong Pacification Commission presented one specimen of lingzhi.

sentences.zh: 十月，濟寧進芝一本。

translations.literal: Tenth month, Jining presented one lingzhi.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the twenty-third year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Jining presented one specimen of lingzhi.

sentences.zh: 二十六年三月癸未，東流縣獻芝。

translations.literal: Year 26, third month, on guiwei day, Dongliu County offered lingzhi.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day in the third month of the twenty-sixth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Dongliu County presented lingzhi as tribute.

sentences.zh: 四月，池州貴池縣民王逸進紫芝十二本。

translations.literal: Fourth month, Chizhou's Guichi County commoner Wang Yi presented twelve purple lingzhi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the twenty-sixth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Wang Yi, a commoner of Guichi County in Chizhou, presented twelve specimens of purple lingzhi.

sentences.zh: 六月，汲縣民朱良進紫芝。

translations.literal: Sixth month, Ji County commoner Zhu Liang presented purple lingzhi.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the twenty-sixth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Zhu Liang, a commoner of Ji County, presented purple lingzhi.

sentences.zh: 二十八年三月，芝生鈞州陽翟縣。

translations.literal: Year 28, third month, lingzhi grew at Jun Prefecture's Yangdi County.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the twenty-eighth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, lingzhi appeared at Yangdi County in Jun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十九年六月，芝生賀州。

translations.literal: Year 29, sixth month, lingzhi grew at He Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the twenty-ninth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, lingzhi appeared at He Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 大德五年十二月，興元西鄉縣進芝一本，色如珊瑚。

translations.literal: Dade year 5, twelfth month, Xingyuan's Xixiang County presented one lingzhi; color like coral.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the fifth year of the Dade reign period, Xixiang County in Xingyuan presented one specimen of lingzhi, coral-red in color.

sentences.zh: 六年正月，濟南鄒平縣進芝一本，五枝五葉，色皆赤。

translations.literal: Year 6, first month, Jinan's Zouping County presented one lingzhi; five branches and five leaves, all colors red.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the sixth year of the Dade reign period, Zouping County in Jinan presented one specimen of lingzhi with five branches and five leaves, all of them red.

sentences.zh: 至大四年八月，芝生國學大成殿。

translations.literal: Zhida year 4, eighth month, lingzhi grew at the Imperial Academy's Hall of Great Completion.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fourth year of the Zhida reign period, lingzhi appeared in the Hall of Great Completion at the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 延祐二年三月，芝生大成殿。

translations.literal: Yanyou year 2, third month, lingzhi grew at the Hall of Great Completion.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the second year of the Yanyou reign period, lingzhi appeared in the Hall of Great Completion.

sentences.zh: 五年七月，芝生大成殿。

translations.literal: Year 5, seventh month, lingzhi grew at the Hall of Great Completion.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fifth year of the Yanyou reign period, lingzhi appeared in the Hall of Great Completion.

sentences.zh: 中統二年正月辛未，禦帳殿受朝賀，是夜，東北有赤氣照人，大如席。

translations.literal: Zhongtong year 2, first month, on xinwei day, at the imperial tent hall received court congratulations; that night, in the northeast there was red vapor shining on people, large as a mat.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day in the first month of the second year of the Zhongtong reign period, the emperor received court congratulations in the imperial tent hall; that night a red glow shone over the northeast, as large as a mat.

sentences.zh: 五行，三曰木。

translations.literal: Of the Five Elements, the third is Wood.
translations.idiomatic: Of the Five Elements, the third is Wood.

sentences.zh: 曲直，木之性也，失其性為沴，故生不暢茂，為變異者有之，是為木不曲直。

translations.literal: Bending and straightening—Wood's nature; when it loses its nature it becomes an aberration. Therefore growth is not flourishing and luxuriant; there are those that become anomalies—this is Wood not bending and straightening.
translations.idiomatic: To bend and grow straight is the nature of Wood; when Wood loses its nature, aberration follows. Growth fails to flourish, anomalies appear, and this is what is meant by Wood no longer bending and growing straight.

sentences.zh: 其征恒雨，其色青，是為青眚青祥。

translations.literal: Its sign is constant rain, its color green—this is green calamity and green auspice.
translations.idiomatic: Its portent is unrelenting rain, its color green—these are the green calamities and green auspices.

sentences.zh: 大德七年十一月辛酉，木冰。

translations.literal: Dade year 7, eleventh month, on xinyou day, tree ice.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day in the eleventh month of the seventh year of the Dade reign period, glazed frost formed on the trees.

sentences.zh: 至順二年十一月丁巳，雨木冰。

translations.literal: Zhishun year 2, eleventh month, on dingsi day, rain tree ice.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day in the eleventh month of the second year of the Zhishun reign period, rain fell with glazed frost on the trees.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥，雨木冰。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on guihai day, rain tree ice.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day in the twelfth month of the second year of the Zhishun reign period, rain fell with glazed frost on the trees.

sentences.zh: 元貞元年，太平路蕪湖縣進榆木，有文曰「天下太平年」。

translations.literal: Yuanzhen year 1, Taiping Circuit's Wuhu County presented elm wood; there was writing saying "Years of Great Peace Under Heaven."
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Yuanzhen reign period, Wuhu County in Taiping Circuit presented a piece of elm wood bearing the inscription "Years of Great Peace Under Heaven."

sentences.zh: 至治三年五月庚子，柳林行宮大木風拔三千七百株。

translations.literal: Zhizhi year 3, fifth month, on gengzi day, at Liulin traveling palace great trees—wind uprooted three thousand seven hundred trunks.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day in the fifth month of the third year of the Zhizhi reign period, a windstorm at the Liulin traveling palace uprooted three thousand seven hundred large trees.

sentences.zh: 至元十七年二月，真定七郡桑有蟲食之。

translations.literal: Zhiyuan year 17, second month, Zhending's seven commanderies—mulberry trees had insects eating them.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the seventeenth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, insects devoured the mulberry trees in the seven commanderies of Zhending.

sentences.zh: 二十九年五月，滄州、濰州，中山，元氏、無棣等縣桑蟲食葉，蠶不成。

translations.literal: Year 29, fifth month, Cang Prefecture, Wei Prefecture, Zhongshan, Yuanshi, Wudi, and other counties—mulberry worms ate the leaves; silkworms did not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the twenty-ninth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, mulberry worms ate the leaves at Cang and Wei prefectures, Zhongshan, Yuanshi, Wudi, and other counties, and the silkworm crop failed.

sentences.zh: 元貞元年四月，真定中山、靈壽二縣桑有蟲食之。

translations.literal: Yuanzhen year 1, fourth month, Zhending's Zhongshan and Lingshou two counties—mulberry trees had insects eating them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the first year of the Yuanzhen reign period, insects devoured the mulberry trees in Zhongshan and Lingshou counties in Zhending.

sentences.zh: 大德五年四月，彰德、廣平、真定、順德、大名等郡蟲食桑。

translations.literal: Dade year 5, fourth month, Zhangde, Guangping, Zhending, Shunde, Daming, and other commanderies—insects ate mulberry.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fifth year of the Dade reign period, insects devoured the mulberry trees in the commanderies of Zhangde, Guangping, Zhending, Shunde, Daming, and others.

sentences.zh: 至大元年五月，大名、廣平、真定三郡蟲食桑。

translations.literal: Zhida year 1, fifth month, Daming, Guangping, Zhending three commanderies—insects ate mulberry.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the first year of the Zhida reign period, insects devoured the mulberry trees in the three commanderies of Daming, Guangping, and Zhending.

sentences.zh: 致和元年六月，河南德安屯蠖食桑。

translations.literal: Zhihe year 1, sixth month, Henan's De'an garrison—tent caterpillars ate mulberry.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first year of the Zhihe reign period, tent caterpillars devoured the mulberry trees at the De'an garrison in Henan.

sentences.zh: 天歷二年三月，滄州、高唐州及南皮、鹽山、武城等縣桑，蟲食之如枯株。

translations.literal: Tianli year 2, third month, Cang Prefecture, Gaotang Prefecture, and Nanpi, Yanshan, Wucheng, and other counties—mulberry trees, insects ate them like withered stumps.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the second year of the Tianli reign period, insects stripped the mulberry trees at Cang and Gaotang prefectures and at Nanpi, Yanshan, Wucheng, and other counties until they stood like dead stumps.

sentences.zh: 至順二年三月，冠州蟲食桑四萬株。

translations.literal: Zhishun year 2, third month, Guan Prefecture—insects ate mulberry, forty thousand trunks.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the second year of the Zhishun reign period, insects devoured forty thousand mulberry trees in Guan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 晉、冀、深、蠡等州及鄆城、延津二縣蟲夜食桑，晝匿土中，人莫捕之。

translations.literal: Jin, Ji, Shen, Li, and other prefectures and Yuncheng and Yanjin two counties—insects by night ate mulberry, by day hid in the earth; people could not catch them.
translations.idiomatic: In Jin, Ji, Shen, Li, and other prefectures and in Yuncheng and Yanjin counties, the insects fed on mulberry at night and hid in the soil by day, so that people could not catch them.

sentences.zh: 五月，曹州禹城、保定博野、東昌封丘等縣蟲食桑，皆既。

translations.literal: Fifth month, Caozhou's Yucheng, Baoding's Boye, Dongchang's Fengqiu, and other counties—insects ate mulberry; all finished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, insects devoured the mulberry trees in Yucheng in Caozhou, Boye in Baoding, Fengqiu in Dongchang, and other counties until the infestation had run its course.

sentences.zh: 至元九年六月丁亥，京師大雨。

translations.literal: Zhiyuan year 9, sixth month, on dinghai day, the capital—great rain.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day in the sixth month of the ninth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, heavy rain fell at the capital.

sentences.zh: 二十四年九月，太原、河間、河南等路霖雨害稼。

translations.literal: Year 24, ninth month, Taiyuan, Hejian, Henan, and other circuits—prolonged rain harmed crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the twenty-fourth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, prolonged rains in Taiyuan, Hejian, Henan, and other circuits damaged the crops.

sentences.zh: 二十五年七月，保定郡，霸、漷二州淫雨害稼。

translations.literal: Year 25, seventh month, Baoding Commandery, Ba and Huo two prefectures—excessive rain harmed crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the twenty-fifth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, excessive rains in Baoding Commandery and in Ba and Huo prefectures damaged the crops.

sentences.zh: 八月，嘉祥、魚臺、金鄉三縣淫雨，九月，莫、獻二州淫雨。

translations.literal: Eighth month, Jiaxiang, Yutai, Jinxiang three counties—excessive rain; ninth month, Mo and Xian two prefectures—excessive rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the twenty-fifth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, excessive rains struck Jiaxiang, Yutai, and Jinxiang counties; in the ninth month, Mo and Xian prefectures were likewise inundated.

sentences.zh: 保定路淫雨。

translations.literal: Baoding Circuit—excessive rain.
translations.idiomatic: Baoding Circuit also suffered excessive rain.

sentences.zh: 二十六年六月，濟寧、東平、汴梁、濟南、順德、真定、平灤、棣州霖雨害稼。

translations.literal: Year 26, sixth month, Jining, Dongping, Bianliang, Jinan, Shunde, Zhending, Pingliang, Di Prefecture—prolonged rain harmed crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the twenty-sixth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, prolonged rains damaged the crops in Jining, Dongping, Bianliang, Jinan, Shunde, Zhending, Pingliang, and Di Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十八年八月，大名、清河、南樂諸縣霖雨為災。

translations.literal: Year 28, eighth month, Daming, Qinghe, Nanle, and other counties—prolonged rain became a disaster.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the twenty-eighth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, prolonged rains brought disaster to Daming, Qinghe, Nanle, and other counties.

sentences.zh: 九月，河間郡淫雨。

translations.literal: Ninth month, Hejian Commandery—excessive rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the twenty-eighth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Hejian Commandery suffered excessive rain.

sentences.zh: 至大四年七月，河間、順德、大名、彰德、廣平等路，德、濮、恩、通等州及河東祁縣霖雨害稼。

translations.literal: Zhida year 4, seventh month, Hejian, Shunde, Daming, Zhangde, Guangping, and other circuits; De, Pu, En, Tong, and other prefectures and Hedong's Qi County—prolonged rain harmed crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fourth year of the Zhida reign period, prolonged rains damaged the crops in the circuits of Hejian, Shunde, Daming, Zhangde, and Guangping, in De, Pu, En, and Tong prefectures, and in Qi County in Hedong.

sentences.zh: 皇慶元年，龍興路新建縣雨害稼。

translations.literal: Huangqing year 1, Longxing Circuit's Xinjian County—rain harmed crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Huangqing reign period, rain damaged the crops at Xinjian County in Longxing Circuit.

sentences.zh: 延祐四年四月，遼陽蓋州雨水害稼。

translations.literal: Yanyou year 4, fourth month, Liaoyang's Gaizhou—rainwater harmed crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fourth year of the Yanyou reign period, rain damaged the crops at Gaizhou in Liaoyang.

sentences.zh: 六年七月，霸州文成縣雨害稼三千餘頃。

translations.literal: Year 6, seventh month, Ba Prefecture's Wencheng County—rain harmed crops more than three thousand qing.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the sixth year of the Yanyou reign period, rain damaged more than three thousand qing of crops at Wencheng County in Ba Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 泰定元年七月，真定、廣平、廬州十一郡雨傷稼。

translations.literal: Taiding year 1, seventh month, Zhending, Guangping, Luzhou eleven commanderies—rain injured crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the first year of the Taiding reign period, rain damaged the crops in eleven commanderies including Zhending, Guangping, and Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月，汴梁考城、儀封，濟南霑化、利津等縣霖雨，損禾稼。

translations.literal: Eighth month, Bianliang's Kaocheng and Yifeng, Jinan's Zhanhua and Lijin, and other counties—prolonged rain; grain crops damaged.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the first year of the Taiding reign period, prolonged rains at Kaocheng and Yifeng in Bianliang and at Zhanhua and Lijin in Jinan, among other counties, damaged the grain crops.

sentences.zh: 五行，四曰金。

translations.literal: Of the Five Elements, the fourth is Metal.
translations.idiomatic: Of the Five Elements, the fourth is Metal.

sentences.zh: 從革，金之性也，失其性為沴，時則冶鑄不成，變異者有之，是為金不從革。

translations.literal: Following and reforming—Metal's nature; when it loses its nature it becomes an aberration. At such times smelting and casting do not succeed; there are those that become anomalies—this is Metal not following and reforming.
translations.idiomatic: To follow change and be reshaped is the nature of Metal; when Metal loses its nature, aberration follows. Smelting and casting then fail, anomalies appear, and this is what is meant by Metal no longer following change and being reshaped.

sentences.zh: 金石同類，故古者以類附見。

translations.literal: Metal and stone are of the same category; therefore the ancients grouped them by category in appended entries.
translations.idiomatic: Metal and stone belong to the same category, and so the ancients recorded them together under related headings.

sentences.zh: 其征恒絜，其色白，是為白眚白祥。

translations.literal: Its sign is constant drought, its color white—this is white calamity and white auspice.
translations.idiomatic: Its portent is unrelenting drought, its color white—these are the white calamities and white auspices.

sentences.zh: 至元十三年，霧靈山伐木官劉氏言，檀州大峪錐山出鐵礦，有司覆視之，尋立四冶。

translations.literal: Zhiyuan year 13, Wuling Mountain timber official Master Liu reported that Tan Prefecture's Dayu Zhuishan produced iron ore; the responsible offices re-inspected it, and soon established four smelteries.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Liu, the timber official at Wuling Mountain, reported that iron ore had been found at Dayu Zhuishan in Tan Prefecture. The authorities sent inspectors to verify the report and soon established four smelting works.

sentences.zh: 大德元年，雲州聚陽山等冶言，礦石煽煉銀貨不出，詔減其課額。

translations.literal: Dade year 1, Yun Prefecture's Juyang Mountain and other smelteries reported that when ore was smelted, silver product would not come out; an edict reduced their tax quotas.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Dade reign period, the smelteries at Juyang Mountain in Yun Prefecture and elsewhere reported that smelting the ore yielded no silver. An edict was issued reducing their tax quotas.

sentences.zh: 二年六月，撫州崇仁縣辛陂村有星隕於地，為綠色隕石，邑人張椿以狀聞。

translations.literal: Year 2, sixth month, Fuzhou's Chongren County Xinpi Village—a star fell to earth; it was a green meteorite; the local man Zhang Chun reported the matter in a memorial.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the second year of the Dade reign period, a meteor fell to earth at Xinpi Village in Chongren County, Fuzhou. It was a green meteorite, and a local man named Zhang Chun reported the event to the authorities.

sentences.zh: 泰定四年八月，天全道山崩，飛石擊人，中者輒死。

translations.literal: Taiding year 4, eighth month, Tianquan Circuit—mountain collapse; flying stones struck people; those hit immediately died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fourth year of the Taiding reign period, a mountainside collapsed in Tianquan Circuit. Flying rocks struck people, and those hit were killed at once.

sentences.zh: 庶征之恒絜，劉向以為《春秋》大旱也。

translations.literal: Of the ordinary portents, constant drought—Liu Xiang considered this the great drought of the Spring and Autumn Annals.
translations.idiomatic: Among the ordinary portents, unrelenting drought—Liu Xiang understood this to signify the great droughts recorded in the Spring and Autumn Annals.

sentences.zh: 京房《易傳》曰：「欲得不用，茲謂張，厥災荒。

translations.literal: Jing Fang's Commentary on the Changes says: "Desiring to obtain yet not employing—this is called expansion; its calamity is desolation.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Fang's Commentary on the Changes says: "To desire gain yet refuse to use it—this is called overreach; its calamity is desolation.

sentences.zh: 」荒，旱也。

translations.literal: Desolation—drought."
translations.idiomatic: Desolation means drought."

sentences.zh: 中統三年五月，濱、棣二州旱。

translations.literal: Zhongtong year 3, fifth month, Bin and Di two prefectures—drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the third year of the Zhongtong reign period, Bin and Di prefectures suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 四年八月，真定郡及洺、磁等州旱。

translations.literal: Year 4, eighth month, Zhending Commandery and Mo, Ci, and other prefectures—drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fourth year of the Zhongtong reign period, Zhending Commandery and Mo, Ci, and other prefectures suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 至元元年二月，東平、太原、平陽旱，分命西僧禱雨。

translations.literal: Zhiyuan year 1, second month, Dongping, Taiyuan, Pingyang—drought; separately ordered Western monks to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the first year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Dongping, Taiyuan, and Pingyang suffered drought, and Western monks were separately dispatched to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 五年十二月，京兆大旱。

translations.literal: Year 5, twelfth month, Jingzhao—great drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the fifth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Jingzhao suffered severe drought.

sentences.zh: 八年四月，蔚州靈仙、廣靈二縣旱。

translations.literal: Year 8, fourth month, Wei Prefecture's Lingxian and Guangling two counties—drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the eighth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Lingxian and Guangling counties in Wei Prefecture suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 九年六月，高麗旱。

translations.literal: Year 9, sixth month, Goryeo—drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the ninth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Goryeo suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 十三年十二月，平陽路旱。

translations.literal: Year 13, twelfth month, Pingyang Circuit—drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the thirteenth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Pingyang Circuit suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 十六年七月，趙州旱。

translations.literal: Year 16, seventh month, Zhao Prefecture—drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the sixteenth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Zhao Prefecture suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 十八年二月，廣寧、北京大定州旱。

translations.literal: Year 18, second month, Guangning, Beijing, Dading Prefecture—drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the eighteenth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Guangning, Beijing, and Dading Prefecture suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 二十三年五月，汴梁旱，京畿旱。

translations.literal: Year 23, fifth month, Bianliang—drought; the capital region—drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the twenty-third year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Bianliang and the capital region both suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 二十四年春，平陽旱，二麥枯死。

translations.literal: Year 24, spring, Pingyang—drought; the two wheats withered and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the twenty-fourth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Pingyang suffered drought, and the winter and spring wheat crops withered and died.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，東平路須城等六縣，安西路商、耀、乾、華等十六州旱。

translations.literal: Year 25, Dongping Circuit's Xucheng and other six counties, Anxi Circuit's Shang, Yao, Qian, Hua, and other sixteen prefectures—drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, drought struck six counties including Xucheng in Dongping Circuit and sixteen prefectures including Shang, Yao, Qian, and Hua in Anxi Circuit.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，絳州大旱。

translations.literal: Year 26, Jiang Prefecture—great drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Jiang Prefecture suffered severe drought.

sentences.zh: 元貞元年六月，環州、葭州及咸寧、伏羌、通渭等縣旱。

translations.literal: Yuanzhen year 1, sixth month, Huan Prefecture, Jia Prefecture, and Xianning, Fuqiang, Tongwei, and other counties—drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first year of the Yuanzhen reign period, Huan and Jia prefectures and Xianning, Fuqiang, Tongwei, and other counties suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 七月，河間肅寧、樂壽二縣旱，泗州、賀州旱。

translations.literal: Seventh month, Hejian's Sunning and Leshou two counties—drought; Si Prefecture, He Prefecture—drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the first year of the Yuanzhen reign period, Sunning and Leshou counties in Hejian, as well as Si and He prefectures, suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 二年八月，大名開州、懷孟武陟縣、河間肅寧縣旱。

translations.literal: Year 2, eighth month, Daming's Kaizhou, Huaimeng's Wuzhi County, Hejian's Sunning County—drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the second year of the Yuanzhen reign period, Kaizhou in Daming, Wuzhi County in Huaimeng, and Sunning County in Hejian suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 九月，莫州、獻州旱。

translations.literal: Ninth month, Mo Prefecture and Xian Prefecture—drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the second year of the Yuanzhen reign period, Mo and Xian prefectures suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 十月，化州旱。

translations.literal: Tenth month, Hua Prefecture—drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the second year of the Yuanzhen reign period, Hua Prefecture suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 十二月，遼東、開元二路旱。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, Liaodong and Kaiyuan two circuits—drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the second year of the Yuanzhen reign period, the Liaodong and Kaiyuan circuits suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 至大三年夏，廣平亢旱。

translations.literal: Zhi Da year 3, summer, Guangping—severe drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the third year of the Zhi Da reign period, Guangping suffered severe drought.

sentences.zh: 皇慶元年六月，濱、棣、德三州及蒲臺、陽信等縣旱。

translations.literal: Huangqing year 1, sixth month, Bin, Di, and De three prefectures and Putai, Yangxin, and other counties—drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first year of the Huangqing reign period, Bin, Di, and De prefectures and Putai, Yangxin, and other counties suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 二年九月，京畿大旱。

translations.literal: Year 2, ninth month, the capital region—great drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the second year of the Huangqing reign period, the capital region suffered severe drought.

sentences.zh: 延祐二年春，檀、薊、濠三州旱。

translations.literal: Yanyou year 2, spring, Tan, Ji, and Hao three prefectures—drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the second year of the Yanyou reign period, Tan, Ji, and Hao prefectures suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 夏，鞏昌蘭州旱。

translations.literal: Summer, Gongchang Lan Prefecture—drought.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, Lan Prefecture in Gongchang suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 四年四月，德安府旱。

translations.literal: Year 4, fourth month, De'an Prefecture—drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fourth year of the Yanyou reign period, De'an Prefecture suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 五年七月，真定、河間、廣平、中山大旱。

translations.literal: Year 5, seventh month, Zhending, Hejian, Guangping, Zhongshan—great drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fifth year of the Yanyou reign period, Zhending, Hejian, Guangping, and Zhongshan suffered severe drought.

sentences.zh: 七年六月，黃、蘄二郡及荊門州旱。

translations.literal: Year 7, sixth month, Huang and Qi two commanderies and Jingmen Prefecture—drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the seventh year of the Yanyou reign period, the Huang and Qi commanderies and Jingmen Prefecture suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 至治元年六月，大同路旱。

translations.literal: Zhizhi year 1, sixth month, Datong Circuit—drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first year of the Zhizhi reign period, Datong Circuit suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 二年十一月，岷州旱。

translations.literal: Year 2, eleventh month, Min Prefecture—drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the second year of the Zhizhi reign period, Min Prefecture suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 三年夏，順德、真定、冀寧大旱。

translations.literal: Year 3, summer, Shunde, Zhending, Jining—great drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the third year of the Zhizhi reign period, Shunde, Zhending, and Jining suffered severe drought.

sentences.zh: 致和元年二月，廣平、彰德等郡旱。

translations.literal: Zhihe year 1, second month, Guangping, Zhangde, and other commanderies—drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the first year of the Zhihe reign period, Guangping, Zhangde, and other commanderies suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 天歷元年八月，陜西大旱，人相食。

translations.literal: Tianli year 1, eighth month, Shaanxi—great drought; people ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the first year of the Tianli reign period, Shaanxi suffered severe drought, and people resorted to cannibalism.

sentences.zh: 二年夏，真定、河間、大名、廣平等四州四十一縣旱。

translations.literal: Year 2, summer, Zhending, Hejian, Daming, Guangping, and other four prefectures and forty-one counties—drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the second year of the Tianli reign period, drought struck four prefectures—Zhending, Hejian, Daming, and Guangping—and forty-one counties.

sentences.zh: 峽州二縣旱。

translations.literal: Xia Prefecture, two counties—drought.
translations.idiomatic: Two counties in Xia Prefecture suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 八月，浙西湖州，江東池州、饒州旱。

translations.literal: Eighth month, Zhexi Huzhou; Jiangdong Chizhou and Raozhou—drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the second year of the Tianli reign period, Huzhou in western Zhejiang and Chizhou and Raozhou in eastern Jiangnan suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 十二月，冀寧路旱。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, Jining Circuit—drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the second year of the Tianli reign period, Jining Circuit suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 至順元年七月，肇州、興州、東勝州及榆次、滏陽等十三縣旱。

translations.literal: Zhishun year 1, seventh month, Zhao Prefecture, Xing Prefecture, Dongsheng Prefecture, and Yuci, Fuyang, and other thirteen counties—drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the first year of the Zhishun reign period, Zhao, Xing, and Dongsheng prefectures and thirteen counties including Yuci and Fuyang suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 二年，霍、隰、石三州，阜城、平地二縣旱。

translations.literal: Year 2, Huo, Xi, and Shi three prefectures; Fucheng and Pingdi two counties—drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Zhishun reign period, Huo, Xi, and Shi prefectures and Fucheng and Pingdi counties suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 恒絜，則有介蟲之孽。

translations.literal: When drought is constant, there are calamities of armored insects.
translations.idiomatic: When drought is unrelenting, calamities of armored insects follow.

sentences.zh: 釋者謂小蟲有甲飛揚之類，陽氣所生也，於《春秋》為螽，今謂之蝗。

translations.literal: Commentators say small insects with shells that fly about belong to the kind born of yang energy; in the Spring and Autumn Annals they are called zhong, and today they are called locusts.
translations.idiomatic: Commentators explain that small shelled insects that take wing are born of yang energy; the Spring and Autumn Annals call them zhong, and today they are called locusts.

sentences.zh: 按劉歆雲，貪虐取民則螽與魚同占。

translations.literal: According to Liu Xin, when greed and tyranny extract from the people, locusts and fish share the same omen.
translations.idiomatic: According to Liu Xin, when rulers are greedy and cruel in their exactions upon the people, locusts and fish carry the same portent.

sentences.zh: 劉向以為介蟲之孽，當屬言不從。

translations.literal: Liu Xiang held that calamities of armored insects belong under speech not being heeded.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xiang held that calamities of armored insects belong to the category of speech not being heeded.

sentences.zh: 今仿之。

translations.literal: Here I follow this.
translations.idiomatic: Here I follow this approach.

sentences.zh: 中統三年五月，真定、順天、邢州蝗。

translations.literal: Zhongtong year 3, fifth month, Zhending, Shuntian, Xing Prefecture—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the third year of the Zhongtong reign period, Zhending, Shuntian, and Xing Prefecture suffered locust plagues.

sentences.zh: 四年六月，燕京、河間、益都、真定、東平蝗。

translations.literal: Year 4, sixth month, Yanjing, Hejian, Yidu, Zhending, Dongping—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fourth year of the Zhongtong reign period, Yanjing, Hejian, Yidu, Zhending, and Dongping suffered locust plagues.

sentences.zh: 八月，濱、棣等州蝗。

translations.literal: Eighth month, Bin, Di, and other prefectures—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fourth year of the Zhongtong reign period, Bin, Di, and other prefectures suffered locust plagues.

sentences.zh: 至元二年七月，益都大蝗。

translations.literal: Zhiyuan year 2, seventh month, Yidu—great locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the second year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Yidu suffered a severe locust plague.

sentences.zh: 十二月，西京、北京、順德、徐、宿、邳等州郡蝗。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, Xijing, Beijing, Shunde, Xu, Su, Pi, and other prefectures and commanderies—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the second year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Xijing, Beijing, Shunde, Xu, Su, Pi, and other prefectures and commanderies suffered locust plagues.

sentences.zh: 五年六月，東平等郡蝗。

translations.literal: Year 5, sixth month, Dongping and other commanderies—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fifth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Dongping and other commanderies suffered locust plagues.

sentences.zh: 七年七月，南京、河南諸路大蝗。

translations.literal: Year 7, seventh month, Nanjing, Henan, and other circuits—great locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the seventh year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Nanjing, Henan, and other circuits suffered severe locust plagues.

sentences.zh: 八年六月，上都、中都、大名、河間、益都、順天、懷孟、彰德、濟南、真定、衛輝、平陽、歸德、順德等路，淄、萊、洺、磁等州蝗。

translations.literal: Year 8, sixth month, Shangdu, Zhongdu, Daming, Hejian, Yidu, Shuntian, Huaimeng, Zhangde, Jinan, Zhending, Weihui, Pingyang, Guide, Shunde, and other circuits; Zi, Lai, Ming, Ci, and other prefectures—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the eighth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, locust plagues struck Shangdu, Zhongdu, Daming, Hejian, Yidu, Shuntian, Huaimeng, Zhangde, Jinan, Zhending, Weihui, Pingyang, Guide, Shunde, and other circuits, as well as Zi, Lai, Ming, Ci, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 十六年四月，大都十六路蝗。

translations.literal: Year 16, fourth month, the capital region, sixteen circuits—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the sixteenth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, locust plagues struck sixteen circuits in the capital region.

sentences.zh: 十七年五月，忻州及漣、海、邳、宿等州蝗。

translations.literal: Year 17, fifth month, Xin Prefecture and Lian, Hai, Pi, Su, and other prefectures—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the seventeenth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Xin Prefecture and Lian, Hai, Pi, Su, and other prefectures suffered locust plagues.

sentences.zh: 十九年四月，別十八里部東三百餘里蝗害麥。

translations.literal: Year 19, fourth month, more than three hundred li east of the Bie Shibali bu—locusts harmed the wheat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the nineteenth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, locusts ravaged the wheat more than three hundred li east of the Bie Shibali bu.

sentences.zh: 二十五年七月，真定、汴梁蝗。

translations.literal: Year 25, seventh month, Zhending, Bianliang—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the twenty-fifth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Zhending and Bianliang suffered locust plagues.

sentences.zh: 八月，趙、晉、冀三州蝗。

translations.literal: Eighth month, Zhao, Jin, and Ji three prefectures—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the twenty-fifth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Zhao, Jin, and Ji prefectures suffered locust plagues.

sentences.zh: 二十七年四月，河北十七郡蝗。

translations.literal: Year 27, fourth month, Hebei, seventeen commanderies—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the twenty-seventh year of the Zhiyuan reign period, seventeen commanderies in Hebei suffered locust plagues.

sentences.zh: 二十九年六月，東昌、濟南、般陽、歸德等郡蝗。

translations.literal: Year 29, sixth month, Dongchang, Jinan, Banyang, Guide, and other commanderies—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the twenty-ninth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Dongchang, Jinan, Banyang, Guide, and other commanderies suffered locust plagues.

sentences.zh: 三十一年六月，東安州蝗。

translations.literal: Year 31, sixth month, Dong'an Prefecture—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the thirty-first year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Dong'an Prefecture suffered a locust plague.

sentences.zh: 大德元年六月，歸德邳州、徐州蝗。

translations.literal: Dade year 1, sixth month, Guide's Pizhou and Xuzhou—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first year of the Dade reign period, Pizhou in Guide and Xuzhou suffered locust plagues.

sentences.zh: 二年四月，燕南、山東、兩淮、江浙、燕南屬縣百五十處蝗。

translations.literal: Year 2, fourth month, Yannan, Shandong, the Two Huai, Jiang-Zhe, and one hundred fifty subordinate counties of Yannan—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the second year of the Dade reign period, locust plagues struck one hundred fifty counties in Yannan, Shandong, the Two Huai, and Jiang-Zhe.

sentences.zh: 三年五月，淮安屬縣蝗，有鹙食之。

translations.literal: Year 3, fifth month, Huai'an's subordinate counties—locusts; there were ibises that ate them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the third year of the Dade reign period, locusts infested the subordinate counties of Huai'an, and ibises came to devour them.

sentences.zh: 十月，隴、陜蝗。

translations.literal: Tenth month, Long and Shan—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the third year of the Dade reign period, Long and Shaan suffered locust plagues.

sentences.zh: 五年六月，順德路、淇州蝗。

translations.literal: Year 5, sixth month, Shunde Circuit and Qi Prefecture—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fifth year of the Dade reign period, Shunde Circuit and Qi Prefecture suffered locust plagues.

sentences.zh: 七月，廣平、真定等路蝗。

translations.literal: Seventh month, Guangping, Zhending, and other circuits—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fifth year of the Dade reign period, Guangping, Zhending, and other circuits suffered locust plagues.

sentences.zh: 八月，河南、淮南、睢、陳、唐、和等州，新野、汝陽、江都、興化等縣蝗。

translations.literal: Eighth month, Henan, Huainan, Sui, Chen, Tang, He, and other prefectures; Xinye, Ruyang, Jiangdu, Xinghua, and other counties—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fifth year of the Dade reign period, locust plagues struck Sui, Chen, Tang, He, and other prefectures in Henan and Huainan, as well as Xinye, Ruyang, Jiangdu, Xinghua, and other counties.

sentences.zh: 六年四月，真定、大名、河間等路蝗。

translations.literal: Year 6, fourth month, Zhending, Daming, Hejian, and other circuits—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the sixth year of the Dade reign period, Zhending, Daming, Hejian, and other circuits suffered locust plagues.

sentences.zh: 七月，大都涿、順、固安三州及濠州鐘離、鎮江丹徒二縣蝗。

translations.literal: Seventh month, the capital region's Zhuo, Shun, and Guo'an three prefectures; Haozhou's Zhongli and Zhenjiang's Dantu two counties—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the sixth year of the Dade reign period, Zhuo, Shun, and Guo'an prefectures in the capital region and Zhongli in Haozhou and Dantu in Zhenjiang suffered locust plagues.

sentences.zh: 七年五月，益都、濟南等路蝗。

translations.literal: Year 7, fifth month, Yidu, Jinan, and other circuits—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the seventh year of the Dade reign period, Yidu, Jinan, and other circuits suffered locust plagues.

sentences.zh: 六年，大寧路蝗。

translations.literal: Year 6, Daning Circuit—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of the Dade reign period, Daning Circuit suffered a locust plague.

sentences.zh: 八年四月，益都臨朐、德州齊河縣蝗。

translations.literal: Year 8, fourth month, Yidu's Linqu and Dezhou's Qihe County—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the eighth year of the Dade reign period, Linqu in Yidu and Qihe County in Dezhou suffered locust plagues.

sentences.zh: 六月，益津縣蝗。

translations.literal: Sixth month, Yijin County—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the eighth year of the Dade reign period, Yijin County suffered a locust plague.

sentences.zh: 九年六月，通、泰、靖海、武清等州縣蝗。

translations.literal: Year 9, sixth month, Tong, Tai, Jinghai, Wuqing, and other prefectures and counties—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the ninth year of the Dade reign period, Tong, Tai, Jinghai, Wuqing, and other prefectures and counties suffered locust plagues.

sentences.zh: 八月，涿州，良鄉、河間南皮、泗州天長等縣及東安、海鹽等州蝗。

translations.literal: Eighth month, Zhuo Prefecture; Liangxiang, Hejian's Nanpi, Sizhou's Tianchang, and other counties; Dong'an, Haiyan, and other prefectures—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the ninth year of the Dade reign period, locust plagues struck Zhuo Prefecture; Liangxiang, Nanpi in Hejian, Tianchang in Sizhou, and other counties; and Dong'an, Haiyan, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 十年四月，大都、真定、河間、保定、河南等郡蝗。

translations.literal: Year 10, fourth month, the capital region, Zhending, Hejian, Baoding, Henan, and other commanderies—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the tenth year of the Dade reign period, the capital region and the commanderies of Zhending, Hejian, Baoding, Henan, and others suffered locust plagues.

sentences.zh: 六月，龍興、南康等郡蝗。

translations.literal: Sixth month, Longxing, Nankang, and other commanderies—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the tenth year of the Dade reign period, Longxing, Nankang, and other commanderies suffered locust plagues.

sentences.zh: 皇慶元年，彰德安陽縣蝗。

translations.literal: Huangqing year 1, Zhangde's Anyang County—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Huangqing reign period, Anyang County in Zhangde suffered a locust plague.

sentences.zh: 延祐七年六月，益都路蝗。

translations.literal: Yanyou year 7, sixth month, Yidu Circuit—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the seventh year of the Yanyou reign period, Yidu Circuit suffered a locust plague.

sentences.zh: 致和元年四月，大都薊州、永平路石城縣蝗。

translations.literal: Zhihe year 1, fourth month, the capital region's Ji Prefecture; Yongping Circuit's Shicheng County—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the first year of the Zhihe reign period, Ji Prefecture in the capital region and Shicheng County in Yongping Circuit suffered locust plagues.

sentences.zh: 鳳翔岐山縣蝗，無麥苗。

translations.literal: Fengxiang's Qishan County—locusts; no wheat seedlings remained.
translations.idiomatic: Locusts struck Qishan County in Fengxiang, leaving no wheat seedlings.

sentences.zh: 五月，潁州及汲縣蝗。

translations.literal: Fifth month, Ying Prefecture and Ji County—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the first year of the Zhihe reign period, Ying Prefecture and Ji County suffered locust plagues.

sentences.zh: 六月，武功縣蝗。

translations.literal: Sixth month, Wugong County—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first year of the Zhihe reign period, Wugong County suffered a locust plague.

sentences.zh: 天歷二年四月，大寧興中州、懷慶孟州、廬州無為州蝗。

translations.literal: Tianli year 2, fourth month, Daning's Xingzhong Prefecture; Huaiqing's Meng Prefecture; Luzhou's Wuwei Prefecture—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the second year of the Tianli reign period, Xingzhong Prefecture in Daning, Meng Prefecture in Huaiqing, and Wuwei Prefecture in Luzhou suffered locust plagues.

sentences.zh: 六月，益都莒、密二州蝗。

translations.literal: Sixth month, Yidu's Ju and Mi two prefectures—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the second year of the Tianli reign period, Ju and Mi prefectures in Yidu suffered locust plagues.

sentences.zh: 七月，真定、汴梁、永平、淮安、廬州、大寧、遼陽等郡屬縣蝗。

translations.literal: Seventh month, Zhending, Bianliang, Yongping, Huai'an, Luzhou, Daning, Liaoyang, and other commanderies' subordinate counties—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the second year of the Tianli reign period, locust plagues struck the subordinate counties of Zhending, Bianliang, Yongping, Huai'an, Luzhou, Daning, Liaoyang, and other commanderies.

sentences.zh: 三年五月，廣平、大名、般陽、濟寧、東平、汴梁、南陽、河南等郡，輝、德、濮、開、高唐五州蝗。

translations.literal: Year 3, fifth month, Guangping, Daming, Banyang, Jining, Dongping, Bianliang, Nanyang, Henan, and other commanderies; Hui, De, Pu, Kai, and Gaotang five prefectures—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the third year of the Tianli reign period, locust plagues struck the commanderies of Guangping, Daming, Banyang, Jining, Dongping, Bianliang, Nanyang, and Henan, as well as the five prefectures of Hui, De, Pu, Kai, and Gaotang.

sentences.zh: 至順元年六月，漷、薊、固安、博興等州蝗。

translations.literal: Zhishun year 1, sixth month, Huo, Ji, Guo'an, Boxing, and other prefectures—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first year of the Zhishun reign period, Huo, Ji, Guo'an, Boxing, and other prefectures suffered locust plagues.

sentences.zh: 七月，解州、華州及河內、靈寶、延津等二十二縣蝗。

translations.literal: Seventh month, Xie Prefecture, Hua Prefecture, and Henan, Lingbao, Yanjin, and other twenty-two counties—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the first year of the Zhishun reign period, Xie and Hua prefectures and twenty-two counties including Henan, Lingbao, and Yanjin suffered locust plagues.

sentences.zh: 二年三月，陜州諸路蝗。

translations.literal: Year 2, third month, Shan Prefecture, various circuits—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the second year of the Zhishun reign period, various circuits in Shan Prefecture suffered locust plagues.

sentences.zh: 六月，孟州濟源縣蝗。

translations.literal: Sixth month, Meng Prefecture's Jiyuan County—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the second year of the Zhishun reign period, Jiyuan County in Meng Prefecture suffered a locust plague.

sentences.zh: 七月，河南閿鄉、陜縣，奉元蒲城、白水等縣蝗。

translations.literal: Seventh month, Henan's Wenxiang and Shan County; Fengyuan's Pucheng, Baishui, and other counties—locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the second year of the Zhishun reign period, locust plagues struck Wenxiang and Shan County in Henan and Pucheng, Baishui, and other counties in Fengyuan.

sentences.zh: 至元十五年四月，濟南無棣縣獲白雉以獻。

translations.literal: Zhiyuan year 15, fourth month, Jinan's Wudi County captured a white pheasant and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fifteenth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Wudi County in Jinan captured a white pheasant and presented it as tribute.

sentences.zh: 元貞三年正月，寧海州牟平縣獲白鹿於聖水山以獻。

translations.literal: Yuanzhen year 3, first month, Ninghai Prefecture's Mouping County captured a white deer on Mount Shengshui and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year of the Yuanzhen reign period, Mouping County in Ninghai Prefecture captured a white deer on Mount Shengshui and presented it as tribute.

sentences.zh: 至元二十四年七月癸丑，日暈連環，白虹貫之。

translations.literal: Zhiyuan year 24, seventh month, day guichou—a solar halo with linked rings; a white rainbow pierced through it.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day of the seventh month of the twenty-fourth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, the sun was ringed by linked halos, and a white rainbow pierced through them.

sentences.zh: 五行，五曰土。

translations.literal: Of the Five Elements, the fifth is Earth.
translations.idiomatic: Of the Five Elements, the fifth is Earth.

sentences.zh: 土，中央生萬物者也，而莫重於稼穡。

translations.literal: Earth is that which at the center gives birth to the myriad things, and nothing is more important than grain crops.
translations.idiomatic: Earth is the element at the center from which the myriad things are born, and nothing is more vital than the grain harvest.

sentences.zh: 土氣不養，則稼穡不成，金木水火沴之，沖氣為異，為地震，為天雨土。

translations.literal: When earth's qi fails to nourish, grain crops do not succeed; Metal, Wood, Water, and Fire aberrate it; clashing qi becomes anomaly—earthquakes, and the sky raining earth.
translations.idiomatic: When Earth's vital force fails to nourish, the harvest fails; Metal, Wood, Water, and Fire then turn aberrant, and clashing energies produce anomalies—earthquakes and earth falling from the sky.

sentences.zh: 其征恒風，其色黃，是為黃眚黃祥。

translations.literal: Its sign is constant wind, its color yellow—this is yellow calamity and yellow auspice.
translations.idiomatic: Its portent is unrelenting wind, its color yellow—these are the yellow calamities and yellow auspices.

sentences.zh: 中統元年五月，澤州、益州饑。

translations.literal: Zhongtong year 1, fifth month, Ze Prefecture and Yi Prefecture—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the first year of the Zhongtong reign period, Ze and Yi prefectures suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 二年六月，塔察兒部饑。

translations.literal: Year 2, sixth month, the Tachar tribe—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the second year of the Zhongtong reign period, the Tachar tribe suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 七月，桓州饑。

translations.literal: Seventh month, Huan Prefecture—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the second year of the Zhongtong reign period, Huan Prefecture suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 三年五月，甘州饑。

translations.literal: Year 3, fifth month, Gan Prefecture—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the third year of the Zhongtong reign period, Gan Prefecture suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 閏九月，濟南郡饑。

translations.literal: Intercalary ninth month, Jinan Commandery—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary ninth month of the third year of the Zhongtong reign period, Jinan Commandery suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 至元二年四月，遼東饑。

translations.literal: Zhiyuan year 2, fourth month, Liaodong—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the second year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Liaodong suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 五年九月，益都饑。

translations.literal: Year 5, ninth month, Yidu—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the fifth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Yidu suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 六年十一月，濟南饑。

translations.literal: Year 6, eleventh month, Jinan—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the sixth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Jinan suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 十一月，固安、高唐二州饑。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, Guo'an and Gaotang two prefectures—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the sixth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Guo'an and Gaotang prefectures suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 七年五月，東京饑。

translations.literal: Year 7, fifth month, Dongjing—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the seventh year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Dongjing suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 七月，山東淄、萊等州饑。

translations.literal: Seventh month, Shandong's Zi, Lai, and other prefectures—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the seventh year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Zi, Lai, and other prefectures in Shandong suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 八年正月，西京、益都饑。

translations.literal: Year 8, first month, Xijing and Yidu—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the eighth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Xijing and Yidu suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 九年四月，京師饑。

translations.literal: Year 9, fourth month, the capital—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the ninth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, the capital suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 七月，水達達部饑。

translations.literal: Seventh month, the Shuidada tribe—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the ninth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, the Shuidada tribe suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 十七年三月，高郵郡饑。

translations.literal: Year 17, third month, Gaoyou Commandery—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the seventeenth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Gaoyou Commandery suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 十八年二月，浙東饑。

translations.literal: Year 18, second month, eastern Zhejiang—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the eighteenth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, eastern Zhejiang suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 四月，通、泰、崇明等州饑。

translations.literal: Fourth month, Tong, Tai, Chongming, and other prefectures—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the eighteenth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Tong, Tai, Chongming, and other prefectures suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 十九年九月，真定路饑，民流徙鄂州。

translations.literal: Year 19, ninth month, Zhending Circuit—famine; the people migrated to Ezhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the nineteenth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Zhending Circuit suffered famine, and the people fled to Ezhou.

sentences.zh: 二十三年七月，宣寧縣饑。

translations.literal: Year 23, seventh month, Xuanning County—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the twenty-third year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Xuanning County suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 二十四年九月，平灤路饑。

translations.literal: Year 24, ninth month, Pingluan Circuit—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the twenty-fourth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Pingluan Circuit suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 十二月，蘇、常、湖、秀四州饑。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, Suzhou, Changzhou, Huzhou, and Xiuzhou four prefectures—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the twenty-fourth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, the four prefectures of Suzhou, Changzhou, Huzhou, and Xiuzhou suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 二十五年十一月，兀良合部饑。

translations.literal: Year 25, eleventh month, the Uriankhai tribe—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the twenty-fifth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, the Uriankhai tribe suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 二十六年二月，合木裏部饑。

translations.literal: Year 26, second month, the Hemuli tribe—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the twenty-sixth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, the Hemuli tribe suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 三月，安西、甘州等路饑。

translations.literal: Third month, Anxi, Gan Prefecture, and other circuits—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the twenty-sixth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Anxi, Gan Prefecture, and other circuits suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 四月，遼陽路饑。

translations.literal: Fourth month, Liaoyang Circuit—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the twenty-sixth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Liaoyang Circuit suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 閏十月，武平路饑，檀州饑。

translations.literal: Intercalary tenth month, Wuping Circuit—famine; Tan Prefecture—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary tenth month of the twenty-sixth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Wuping Circuit and Tan Prefecture suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 十二月，蠡州饑，河間、保定二路饑。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, Lixian—famine; Hejian and Baoding two circuits—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the twenty-sixth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Lixian and the two circuits of Hejian and Baoding suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 二十七年二月，開元路寧遠縣饑。
