translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year of the Tianli reign period, Datong and Dongsheng Prefecture suffered famine, as did Fangshan, Fanyang, and other counties in Zhuo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 四月，奉元耀州、乾州、華州及延安、邠、寧諸縣饑，流民數十萬。

translations.literal: Fourth month, Fengyuan's Yao Prefecture, Qian Prefecture, and Hua Prefecture and Yan'an, Bin, and Ning counties—famine; displaced persons numbered several hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the second year of the Tianli reign period, Yao, Qian, and Hua prefectures in Fengyuan and the counties of Yan'an, Bin, and Ning suffered famine, and several hundred thousand people were displaced.

sentences.zh: 大都、興和、順德、大名、彰德、懷慶、衛輝、汴梁、中興等路，泰安、高唐、曹、冠、徐、邳等州饑。

translations.literal: Dadu, Xinghe, Shunde, Daming, Zhangde, Huaiqing, Weihui, Bianliang, Zhongxing, and other circuits; Tai'an, Gaotang, Cao, Guan, Xu, Pi, and other prefectures—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the second year of the Tianli reign period, Dadu, Xinghe, Shunde, Daming, Zhangde, Huaiqing, Weihui, Bianliang, Zhongxing, and other circuits and Tai'an, Gaotang, Cao, Guan, Xu, Pi, and other prefectures suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 江東、浙西二道饑。

translations.literal: The Jiangdong and Zhexi two circuits—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the second year of the Tianli reign period, the two circuits of Jiangdong and Zhexi suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 八月，忻州饑。

translations.literal: Eighth month, Xin Prefecture—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the second year of the Tianli reign period, Xin Prefecture suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 十月，漢陽、武昌、常德、澧州等路饑，鳳翔府大饑。

translations.literal: Tenth month, Hanyang, Wuchang, Changde, Li Prefecture, and other circuits—famine; Fengxiang Prefecture—great famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the second year of the Tianli reign period, Hanyang, Wuchang, Changde, Li Prefecture, and other circuits suffered famine, and Fengxiang Prefecture suffered severe famine.

sentences.zh: 三年正月，寧海州文登、牟平縣饑，懷慶、衡州二路饑，真定、汝寧、揚、廬、蘄、黃、安豐等郡饑。

translations.literal: Year 3, first month, Ninghai Prefecture's Wendeng and Mouping counties—famine; Huaiqing and Heng Prefecture two circuits—famine; Zhending, Runing, Yang, Lu, Qi, Huang, and Anfeng commanderies—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year of the Tianli reign period, Wendeng and Mouping counties in Ninghai Prefecture, the two circuits of Huaiqing and Heng Prefecture, and the commanderies of Zhending, Runing, Yang, Lu, Qi, Huang, and Anfeng suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 二月，河南大饑。

translations.literal: Second month, Henan—great famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the third year of the Tianli reign period, Henan suffered severe famine.

sentences.zh: 三月，東昌須城、堂邑縣饑。

translations.literal: Third month, Dongchang's Xucheng and Tangyi counties—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the third year of the Tianli reign period, Xucheng and Tangyi counties in Dongchang suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 沂、莒、膠、密、寧海五州，臨清、定陶、光山等縣饑。

translations.literal: Yi, Ju, Jiao, Mi, and Ninghai five prefectures; Linqing, Dingtao, Guangshan, and other counties—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the third year of the Tianli reign period, the five prefectures of Yi, Ju, Jiao, Mi, and Ninghai and Linqing, Dingtao, Guangshan, and other counties suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 鞏昌蘭州、定西州饑。

translations.literal: Gongchang's Lan Prefecture and Dingxi Prefecture—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the third year of the Tianli reign period, Lan Prefecture and Dingxi Prefecture in Gongchang suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 四月，德州清平縣饑。

translations.literal: Fourth month, Dezhou's Qingping County—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the third year of the Tianli reign period, Qingping County in Dezhou suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 至順二年二月，集慶、嘉興二郡及江陰州饑，檀、順、維、密、昌平五州饑。

translations.literal: Zhishun year 2, second month, Jiqing and Jiaxing two commanderies and Jiangyin Prefecture—famine; Tan, Shun, Wei, Mi, and Changping five prefectures—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the second year of the Zhishun reign period, the two commanderies of Jiqing and Jiaxing and Jiangyin Prefecture suffered famine, as did the five prefectures of Tan, Shun, Wei, Mi, and Changping.

sentences.zh: 六月，興和路高原，咸平等縣饑。

translations.literal: Sixth month, Xinghe Circuit's Gaoyuan, Xianping, and other counties—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the second year of the Zhishun reign period, Gaoyuan, Xianping, and other counties in Xinghe Circuit suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 九月，思州鎮遠府饑。

translations.literal: Ninth month, Sizhou's Zhenyuan Prefecture—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the second year of the Zhishun reign period, Zhenyuan Prefecture in Sizhou suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 十二月，河南大饑。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, Henan—great famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the second year of the Zhishun reign period, Henan suffered severe famine.

sentences.zh: 三年四月，大理、中慶路饑。

translations.literal: Year 3, fourth month, Dali and Zhongqing Circuit—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the third year of the Zhishun reign period, Dali and Zhongqing Circuit suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 五月，常寧州饑。

translations.literal: Fifth month, Changning Prefecture—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the third year of the Zhishun reign period, Changning Prefecture suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 七月，勝州饑。

translations.literal: Seventh month, Sheng Prefecture—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the third year of the Zhishun reign period, Sheng Prefecture suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 八月，大都寶坻縣饑。

translations.literal: Eighth month, the capital's Baodi County—famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the third year of the Zhishun reign period, Baodi County in the capital region suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 至大元年春，紹興、慶元、臺州疫死者二萬六千餘人。

translations.literal: Zhi Da year 1, spring, Shaoxing, Qingyuan, and Taizhou—those who died of plague numbered more than twenty-six thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the first year of the Zhi Da reign period, more than twenty-six thousand people died of plague in Shaoxing, Qingyuan, and Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 皇慶二年冬，京師大疫。

translations.literal: Huangqing year 2, winter, the capital—great plague.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the second year of the Huangqing reign period, the capital was stricken by a severe plague.

sentences.zh: 《唐志》云：「國將有恤，則邪亂之氣先被於民，故疫。

translations.literal: The Tang Annals says: "When the state is about to have mourning, then evil and chaotic qi first afflicts the people, hence plague.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang Annals states: "When the state is about to suffer calamity, evil and chaotic forces first descend upon the people, and plague follows.

sentences.zh: 」太宗五年癸巳十二月，大風霾，凡七晝夜。

translations.literal: " In Taizong year 5, guisi, twelfth month, great wind and haze, in all seven days and nights.
translations.idiomatic: " In the twelfth month of the fifth year of Taizong's reign, the year guisi, a great wind and haze lasted seven days and nights.

sentences.zh: 至元二十年正月，汴梁延津、封丘二縣大風，麥苗盡拔。

translations.literal: Zhiyuan year 20, first month, Bianliang's Yanjin and Fengqiu two counties—great wind; wheat seedlings entirely uprooted.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twentieth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, a fierce gale at Yanjin and Fengqiu counties in Bianliang uprooted the wheat seedlings entirely.

sentences.zh: 延祐七年八月，延津縣大風，晝晦，桑隕者十八九。

translations.literal: Yanyou year 7, eighth month, Yanjin County—great wind; day darkened; mulberry trees felled, eight or nine tenths.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the seventh year of the Yanyou reign period, a fierce gale at Yanjin County darkened the daylight, and eight or nine tenths of the mulberry trees were blown down.

sentences.zh: 泰定三年七月，寶坻、房山二縣大風折木。

translations.literal: Taiding year 3, seventh month, Baodi and Fangshan two counties—great wind snapped trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the third year of the Taiding reign period, fierce winds at Baodi and Fangshan counties snapped trees.

sentences.zh: 八月，大都昌平等縣大風一晝夜，壞民居九百餘家。

translations.literal: Eighth month, the capital's Changping and other counties—great wind one day and night; ruined civilian dwellings more than nine hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the third year of the Taiding reign period, a gale lasting a full day and night at Changping and other counties in the capital region destroyed more than nine hundred dwellings.

sentences.zh: 四年五月，衛輝路輝州大風九日，禾盡偃。

translations.literal: Year 4, fifth month, Weihui Circuit's Huizhou—great wind nine days; grain entirely flattened.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fourth year of the Taiding reign period, a gale at Huizhou in Weihui Circuit lasted nine days and flattened the grain crop entirely.

sentences.zh: 天歷三年二月，胙城縣、新鄉縣大風。

translations.literal: Tianli year 3, second month, Zuocheng County and Xinxiang County—great wind.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the third year of the Tianli reign period, fierce winds struck Zuocheng and Xinxiang counties.

sentences.zh: 按《漢志》云：「溫而風則生螟丱，有裸蟲之孽。」

translations.literal: According to the Han Annals: "When warm and windy, stem borers and larvae are produced; there is the calamity of naked insects."
translations.idiomatic: The Han Annals observes: "Warm weather with wind breeds stem borers and larvae—the calamity of bare-skinned insects."

sentences.zh: 至元八年六月，遼州和順縣、解州聞喜縣虸蚄生。

translations.literal: Zhiyuan year 8, sixth month, Liaozhou's Heshun County and Jie Prefecture's Wenxi County—armyworms appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the eighth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, armyworms appeared at Heshun County in Liaozhou and Wenxi County in Jie Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十八年，高唐、夏津、武城縣蟊。

translations.literal: Year 18, Gaotang, Xiajin, and Wucheng counties—crop pests.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, crop pests infested Gaotang, Xiajin, and Wucheng counties.

sentences.zh: 二十三年五月，霸州、漷州蝻。

translations.literal: Year 23, fifth month, Bazhou and Huozhou—locust nymphs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the twenty-third year of the Zhiyuan reign period, locust nymphs appeared at Bazhou and Huozhou.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，鞏昌虸蚄為災。

translations.literal: Year 24, Gongchang—armyworms became a calamity.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, armyworms ravaged Gongchang.

sentences.zh: 二十七年四月，婺州螟害稼，雷雨大作，螟盡死，歲乃大稔。

translations.literal: Year 27, fourth month, Wuzhou—stem borers harmed the crops; thunder and rain arose greatly; stem borers all died; the year then had great abundance.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the twenty-seventh year of the Zhiyuan reign period, stem borers damaged the crops at Wuzhou, but a great thunderstorm killed them all, and the year brought a bountiful harvest.

sentences.zh: 元貞元年六月，利州龍山縣、蓋州明山縣螟。

translations.literal: Yuanzhen year 1, sixth month, Lizhou's Longshan County and Gaizhou's Mingshan County—stem borers.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first year of the Yuanzhen reign period, stem borers infested Longshan County in Lizhou and Mingshan County in Gaizhou.

sentences.zh: 二年五月，濟州任城縣螟。

translations.literal: Year 2, fifth month, Ji Prefecture's Rencheng County—stem borers.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the second year of the Yuanzhen reign period, stem borers infested Rencheng County in Ji Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 隨州野蠶成繭，亙數百里，民取為纊。

translations.literal: Suizhou—wild silkworms formed cocoons, extending several hundred li; the people took them for floss.
translations.idiomatic: At Suizhou, wild silkworms spun cocoons across several hundred li, and the people gathered the silk to make floss.

sentences.zh: 大德七年五月，濟南、東昌、般陽、益都等路蟲食麥。

translations.literal: Dade year 7, fifth month, Jinan, Dongchang, Banyang, Yidu, and other circuits—insects ate wheat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the seventh year of the Dade reign period, insects devoured the wheat in Jinan, Dongchang, Banyang, Yidu, and other circuits.

sentences.zh: 閏五月，汴梁開封縣蟲食麥。

translations.literal: Intercalary fifth month, Bianliang's Kaifeng County—insects ate wheat.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fifth month of the seventh year of the Dade reign period, insects devoured the wheat at Kaifeng County in Bianliang.

sentences.zh: 九年七月，桂陽郡蝝。

translations.literal: Year 9, seventh month, Guiyang Commandery—young locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the ninth year of the Dade reign period, young locusts appeared in Guiyang Commandery.

sentences.zh: 至大元年五月，東平、東昌、益都等郡蝝。

translations.literal: Zhi Da year 1, fifth month, Dongping, Dongchang, Yidu, and other commanderies—young locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the first year of the Zhi Da reign period, young locusts appeared in Dongping, Dongchang, Yidu, and other commanderies.

sentences.zh: 皇慶二年五月，檀州及獲鹿縣蝻。

translations.literal: Huangqing year 2, fifth month, Tan Prefecture and Huolu County—locust nymphs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the second year of the Huangqing reign period, locust nymphs appeared at Tan Prefecture and Huolu County.

sentences.zh: 延祐七年七月，霸州及堂邑縣蝻。

translations.literal: Yanyou year 7, seventh month, Bazhou and Tangyi County—locust nymphs.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the seventh year of the Yanyou reign period, locust nymphs appeared at Bazhou and Tangyi County.

sentences.zh: 泰定四年七月，奉元路咸陽、興平、武功三縣，鳳翔府岐山等縣虸蚄害稼。

translations.literal: Taiding year 4, seventh month, Fengyuan Circuit's Xianyang, Xingping, and Wugong three counties; Fengxiang Prefecture's Qishan and other counties—armyworms harmed the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fourth year of the Taiding reign period, armyworms damaged the crops at Xianyang, Xingping, and Wugong counties in Fengyuan Circuit and at Qishan and other counties in Fengxiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 天歷二年，淮安、廬州、安豐三路屬縣蝻。

translations.literal: Tianli year 2, Huai'an, Luzhou, and Anfeng three circuits' subordinate counties—locust nymphs.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Tianli reign period, locust nymphs appeared in counties under the three circuits of Huai'an, Luzhou, and Anfeng.

sentences.zh: 至元十六年四月，益都樂安縣朱五十家，牛生牸犢，兩頭四耳三尾，其色黃，既生即死。

translations.literal: Zhiyuan year 16, fourth month, Yidu's Le'an County, Zhu Wushi's household—a cow bore a heifer calf with two heads, four ears, and three tails; its color yellow; once born it immediately died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the sixteenth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, at the home of Zhu Wushi in Le'an County, Yidu, a cow gave birth to a heifer calf with two heads, four ears, and three tails. It was yellow and died the moment it was born.

sentences.zh: 大德九年二月，大同平地縣迷兒的斤家，牛生麒麟而死。

translations.literal: Dade year 9, second month, Datong Pingdi County, Mierdejin's household—a cow bore a qilin and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the ninth year of the Dade reign period, at the home of Mierdejin in Pingdi County, Datong, a cow gave birth to a qilin and died.

sentences.zh: 至大四年，大同宣寧縣民滅的家，牛生一犢，其質有鱗無毛，其色青黃，類若麟者，以其鞹上之。

translations.literal: Zhi Da year 4, Datong Xuanning County commoner Miede's household—a cow bore one calf; its substance had scales and no hair; its color bluish-yellow, resembling a qilin; they presented its hide to the court.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of the Zhi Da reign period, at the home of the commoner Miede in Xuanning County, Datong, a cow gave birth to a calf covered in scales rather than hair, bluish-yellow in color and qilin-like in appearance. Its hide was presented to the court.

sentences.zh: 泰定三年九月，湖州長興州民王俊家，牛生一獸，鱗身牛尾，口目皆赤，墮地即大鳴，母不乳之。

translations.literal: Taiding year 3, ninth month, Huzhou Changxing Prefecture commoner Wang Jun's household—a cow bore one beast; scaly body and ox tail; mouth and eyes all red; upon falling to earth it immediately cried loudly; the mother would not suckle it.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the third year of the Taiding reign period, at the home of the commoner Wang Jun in Changxing Prefecture, Huzhou, a cow gave birth to a creature with a scaly body and an ox's tail, red mouth and eyes. It wailed loudly the moment it fell to the ground, and its mother refused to nurse it.

sentences.zh: 具圖以上，不知何獸，或曰：「此瑞也，宜俾史臣紀錄。」

translations.literal: A complete illustration was submitted to the court; none knew what beast it was; some said: "This is an auspicious sign; the court historians ought to record it."
translations.idiomatic: A detailed illustration was sent up to the court. No one could identify the creature, though some said, "This is an auspicious omen and ought to be recorded by the court historians."

sentences.zh: 至元二十四年，諸王薛徹都部雨土七晝夜，沒死牛畜。

translations.literal: Zhiyuan year 24, Prince Xiechedu's encampment—earth rained seven days and nights; submerged and killed cattle and livestock.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, earth fell from the sky for seven days and nights over Prince Xiechedu's encampment, burying and killing cattle and livestock.

sentences.zh: 大德十年二月，大同平地縣雨沙黑霾，斃牛馬二千。

translations.literal: Dade year 10, second month, Datong Pingdi County—sand rained, black haze; two thousand oxen and horses perished.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the tenth year of the Dade reign period, sand and black haze fell at Pingdi County, Datong, killing two thousand oxen and horses.

sentences.zh: 至治三年二月丙戌，雨土。

translations.literal: Zhizhi year 3, second month, on bingxu day—earth rained.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day in the second month of the third year of the Zhizhi reign period, earth fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 致和元年三月壬申，雨霾。

translations.literal: Zhihe year 1, third month, on renshen day—haze rained.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day in the third month of the first year of the Zhihe reign period, haze fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 天歷二年三月丁亥，雨土霾。

translations.literal: Tianli year 2, third month, on dinghai day—earth and haze rained.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day in the third month of the second year of the Tianli reign period, earth and haze fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 至順二年三月丙戌，雨土霾。

translations.literal: Zhishun year 2, third month, on bingxu day—earth and haze rained.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day in the third month of the second year of the Zhishun reign period, earth and haze fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 至元二十一年九月戊子，京師地震。

translations.literal: Zhiyuan year 21, ninth month, on wuzi day, the capital—earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day in the ninth month of the twenty-first year of the Zhiyuan reign period, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 按《傳》云：「陽伏而不能出，陰迫而不能升，於是有地震。

translations.literal: According to the Commentary: "Yang lies hidden and cannot emerge; yin presses and cannot rise—thereupon there is earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: The Commentary explains: "When yang force lies buried and cannot break forth, and yin force presses down and cannot ascend, earthquakes occur.

sentences.zh: 」二十六年正月丙戌，地震。

translations.literal: " Year 26, first month, on bingxu day—earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: " On bingxu day in the first month of the twenty-sixth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, there was an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 二十七年二月癸未，泉州地震。

translations.literal: Year 27, second month, on guiwei day, Quanzhou—earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day in the second month of the twenty-seventh year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Quanzhou was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，泉州地復震。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, Quanzhou's land again quaked.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Quanzhou was shaken again.

sentences.zh: 八月癸未，武平路地大震。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on guiwei day, Wuping Circuit—the land greatly quaked.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day in the eighth month of the twenty-seventh year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Wuping Circuit was shaken by a major earthquake.

sentences.zh: 二十八年八月己丑，平陽路地震，壞廬舍萬八百區。

translations.literal: Year 28, eighth month, on jichou day, Pingyang Circuit—earthquake; ruined dwellings ten thousand eight hundred units.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day in the eighth month of the twenty-eighth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, an earthquake at Pingyang Circuit destroyed ten thousand eight hundred dwellings.

sentences.zh: 元貞元年三月壬戌，地震。

translations.literal: Yuanzhen year 1, third month, on renxu day—earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day in the third month of the first year of the Yuanzhen reign period, there was an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 大德六年十二月辛酉，雲南地震，戊辰亦如之。

translations.literal: Dade year 6, twelfth month, on xinyou day, Yunnan—earthquake; on wuchen day likewise.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day in the twelfth month of the sixth year of the Dade reign period, Yunnan was shaken by an earthquake, and on wuchen day it quaked again.

sentences.zh: 七年八月辛卯夕，地震，太原、平陽尤甚，壞官民廬舍十萬計。

translations.literal: Year 7, eighth month, on xinmao evening—earthquake; Taiyuan and Pingyang especially severe; ruined official and civilian dwellings on the order of one hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: On the evening of xinmao day in the eighth month of the seventh year of the Dade reign period, an earthquake struck, worst at Taiyuan and Pingyang, destroying on the order of one hundred thousand official and civilian dwellings.

sentences.zh: 平陽趙城縣範宣義郇堡徙十餘里。

translations.literal: Pingyang's Zhaocheng County, Fan Xuanyi's Xun fort—shifted more than ten li.
translations.idiomatic: At Xun Fort in Zhaocheng County, Pingyang, the holding of Fan Xuanyi shifted more than ten li.

sentences.zh: 太原徐溝、祁縣及汾州平遙、介休、西河、孝義等縣地震成渠，泉湧黑沙。

translations.literal: Taiyuan's Xugou and Qi counties and Fen Prefecture's Pingyao, Jiexiu, Xihe, Xiaoyi, and other counties—earthquake formed channels; springs gushed black sand.
translations.idiomatic: At Xugou and Qi counties in Taiyuan and at Pingyao, Jiexiu, Xihe, Xiaoyi, and other counties in Fen Prefecture, the earthquake opened channels in the earth and springs gushed forth black sand.

sentences.zh: 汾州北城陷，長一里，東城陷七十餘步。

translations.literal: Fen Prefecture's north wall collapsed, length one li; east wall collapsed more than seventy paces.
translations.idiomatic: The north wall of Fen Prefecture's city collapsed along a stretch one li long, and the east wall sank more than seventy paces.

sentences.zh: 八年正月，平陽地震不止。

translations.literal: Year 8, first month, Pingyang—earthquake did not cease.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the eighth year of the Dade reign period, earthquakes at Pingyang did not cease.

sentences.zh: 九年四月己酉，大同路地震，有聲如雷，壞廬舍五千八百，壓死者一千四百餘人。

translations.literal: Year 9, fourth month, on jiyou day, Datong Circuit—earthquake; sound like thunder; ruined dwellings five thousand eight hundred; crushed dead more than one thousand four hundred people.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day in the fourth month of the ninth year of the Dade reign period, an earthquake at Datong Circuit roared like thunder, destroying five thousand eight hundred dwellings and killing more than fourteen hundred people.

sentences.zh: 懷仁縣地震，二所湧水盡黑，其一廣十八步，深十五丈，其一廣六十六步，深一丈。

translations.literal: Huairen County—earthquake; two places gushed water all black; one breadth eighteen paces, depth fifteen zhang; one breadth sixty-six paces, depth one zhang.
translations.idiomatic: At Huairen County, the earthquake opened two places where black water gushed forth—one eighteen paces wide and fifteen zhang deep, the other sixty-six paces wide and one zhang deep.

sentences.zh: 五月癸亥，以地震，改平陽路為晉寧，太原路為冀寧。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on guihai day, because of the earthquake, changed Pingyang Circuit to Jinning, Taiyuan Circuit to Jining.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day in the fifth month of the ninth year of the Dade reign period, because of the earthquake, Pingyang Circuit was renamed Jinning and Taiyuan Circuit was renamed Jining.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬子，大同地震。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on renzi day, Datong—earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day in the eleventh month of the ninth year of the Dade reign period, Datong was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙子，地震。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on bingzi day—earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day in the twelfth month of the ninth year of the Dade reign period, there was an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 十年正月，晉寧、冀寧地震不止。

translations.literal: Year 10, first month, Jinning and Jining—earthquake did not cease.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the tenth year of the Dade reign period, earthquakes at Jinning and Jining did not cease.

sentences.zh: 十一年三月，道州營道縣暴雨，山裂百三十餘處。

translations.literal: Year 11, third month, Da Prefecture's Yingdao County—violent rain; mountains split more than one hundred thirty places.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the eleventh year of the Dade reign period, torrential rain at Yingdao County in Da Prefecture split the mountains in more than one hundred thirty places.

sentences.zh: 八月壬寅，開成路地震。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on renyin day, Kaicheng Circuit—earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day in the eighth month of the eleventh year of the Dade reign period, Kaicheng Circuit was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 至大元年六月丁酉，鞏昌隴西、寧遠縣地震。

translations.literal: Zhi Da year 1, sixth month, on dingyou day, Gongchang's Longxi and Ningyuan counties—earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day in the sixth month of the first year of the Zhi Da reign period, Longxi and Ningyuan counties in Gongchang were shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 雲南烏撒、烏蒙地三日而大震者六。

translations.literal: Yunnan's Wusa and Wumeng lands—in three days, great quakes numbered six.
translations.idiomatic: In Wusa and Wumeng in Yunnan, six major earthquakes struck within three days.

sentences.zh: 九月己酉，蒲縣地震。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on jiyou day, Pu County—earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day in the ninth month of the first year of the Zhi Da reign period, Pu County was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 十月癸巳，蒲縣、靈縣地震。

translations.literal: Tenth month, on guisi day, Pu County and Ling County—earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day in the tenth month of the first year of the Zhi Da reign period, Pu and Ling counties were shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 二年十二月壬戌，陽曲縣地震有聲。

translations.literal: Year 2, twelfth month, on renxu day, Yangqu County—earthquake with sound.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day in the twelfth month of the second year of the Zhi Da reign period, an audible earthquake struck Yangqu County.

sentences.zh: 三年十二月戊申，冀寧路地震。

translations.literal: Year 3, twelfth month, on wushen day, Jining Circuit—earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day in the twelfth month of the third year of the Zhi Da reign period, Jining Circuit was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 四年三月己亥，寧夏路地震。

translations.literal: Year 4, third month, on jihai day, Ningxia Circuit—earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day in the third month of the fourth year of the Zhi Da reign period, Ningxia Circuit was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 七月癸未，甘州地震，大風，有聲如雷。

translations.literal: Seventh month, on guiwei day, Gan Prefecture—earthquake; great wind; sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day in the seventh month of the fourth year of the Zhi Da reign period, Gan Prefecture was shaken by an earthquake accompanied by a great wind that roared like thunder.

sentences.zh: 閏七月甲子，寧夏地震。

translations.literal: Intercalary seventh month, on jiazi day, Ningxia—earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day in the intercalary seventh month of the fourth year of the Zhi Da reign period, Ningxia was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 皇慶二年六月，京師地震。

translations.literal: Huangqing year 2, sixth month, the capital—earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the second year of the Huangqing reign period, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 己未，京師地震，丙寅又震，壬寅又震。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, the capital—earthquake; on bingyin again quaked; on renyin again quaked.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day the capital quaked; on bingyin it quaked again, and on renyin it quaked once more.

sentences.zh: 至治二年九月癸亥，地震。

translations.literal: Zhizhi year 2, ninth month, on guihai day—earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day in the ninth month of the second year of the Zhizhi reign period, there was an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸卯，地震。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on guimao day—earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day in the eleventh month of the second year of the Zhizhi reign period, there was an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 泰定元年八月，成紀縣大雨，山崩水溢，壅土至來谷河成丘阜。

translations.literal: Taiding year 1, eighth month, Chengji County—great rain; mountains collapsed and water overflowed; piled earth reached Laigu River and formed mounds.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the first year of the Taiding reign period, heavy rain at Chengji County caused mountains to collapse and waters to overflow; earth piled up along the Laigu River until it formed hillocks.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚申，奉元路同州地震，有聲如雷。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on gengshen day, Fengyuan Circuit's Tong Prefecture—earthquake; sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day in the twelfth month of the first year of the Taiding reign period, Tong Prefecture in Fengyuan Circuit was shaken by an earthquake that roared like thunder.

sentences.zh: 三年十二月丁亥，寧夏路地震如雷，發自西北，連震者三。

translations.literal: Year 3, twelfth month, on dinghai day, Ningxia Circuit—earthquake like thunder; originating from the northwest; connected quakes numbered three.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day in the twelfth month of the third year of the Taiding reign period, Ningxia Circuit was shaken by three successive earthquakes roaring like thunder from the northwest.

sentences.zh: 四年三月癸卯，和寧路地震如雷。

translations.literal: Year 4, third month, on guimao day, Hening Circuit—earthquake like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day in the third month of the fourth year of the Taiding reign period, Hening Circuit was shaken by an earthquake that roared like thunder.

sentences.zh: 八月，鞏昌通渭縣山崩。

translations.literal: Eighth month, Gongchang's Tongwei County—mountains collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fourth year of the Taiding reign period, mountains collapsed at Tongwei County in Gongchang.

sentences.zh: 碉門地震，有聲如雷，晝晦。

translations.literal: Diaomen—earthquake; sound like thunder; day darkened.
translations.idiomatic: At Diaomen, an earthquake roared like thunder and darkened the daylight.

sentences.zh: 鳳翔、興元、成都、陜州、江陵等郡地同日震。

translations.literal: Fengxiang, Xingyuan, Chengdu, Shan Prefecture, Jiangling, and other commanderies' lands—all quaked the same day.
translations.idiomatic: On the same day, the earth quaked at Fengxiang, Xingyuan, Chengdu, Shan Prefecture, Jiangling, and other commanderies.

sentences.zh: 九月壬寅，寧夏地震。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on renyin day, Ningxia—earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day in the ninth month of the fourth year of the Taiding reign period, Ningxia was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 致和元年七月辛酉朔，寧夏地震。

translations.literal: Zhihe year 1, seventh month, on xinyou, first day of the month, Ningxia—earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the seventh month, xinyou day, in the first year of the Zhihe reign period, Ningxia was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 己卯，大寧路地震。

translations.literal: On jimao day, Daning Circuit—earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day in the seventh month of the first year of the Zhihe reign period, Daning Circuit was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 十月壬寅，大寧路地震。

translations.literal: Tenth month, on renyin day, Daning Circuit—earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day in the tenth month of the first year of the Zhihe reign period, Daning Circuit was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 至順二年四月丁亥，真定涉縣地一日五震或三震，月餘乃止。

translations.literal: Zhishun year 2, fourth month, on dinghai day, Zhending's She County—land in one day quaked five times or three times; more than a month before it ceased.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day in the fourth month of the second year of the Zhishun reign period, the earth at She County in Zhending quaked five times or three times in a single day, and the tremors did not cease for more than a month.

sentences.zh: 四年四月戊申，大寧路地震。

translations.literal: Year 4, fourth month, on wushen day, Daning Circuit—earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day in the fourth month of the fourth year of the Zhishun reign period, Daning Circuit was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 五月戊寅，京師地震有聲。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on wuyin day, the capital—earthquake with sound.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day in the fifth month of the fourth year of the Zhishun reign period, an audible earthquake struck the capital.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，隴西地震。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on jiyou day, Longxi—earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day in the eighth month of the fourth year of the Zhishun reign period, Longxi was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 至元元年十月壬子，恩州歷亭縣進嘉禾，一莖九穗。

translations.literal: Zhiyuan year 1, tenth month, on renzi day, En Prefecture's Liting County—presented auspicious grain; one stalk nine ears.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day in the tenth month of the first year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Liting County in En Prefecture presented auspicious grain—one stalk with nine ears.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁酉，太原臨州進嘉禾二莖。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on dingyou day, Taiyuan's Lin Prefecture—presented auspicious grain, two stalks.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day in the eleventh month of the first year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Lin Prefecture in Taiyuan presented two stalks of auspicious grain.

sentences.zh: 四年十月庚午，太原進嘉禾二本，異畝同穎。

translations.literal: Year 4, tenth month, on gengwu day, Taiyuan—presented auspicious grain two stalks; different furrows, same ear.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day in the tenth month of the fourth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Taiyuan presented two stalks of auspicious grain from different furrows sharing a single ear.

sentences.zh: 六年九月癸丑，恩州進嘉禾，一莖三穗。

translations.literal: Year 6, ninth month, on guichou day, En Prefecture—presented auspicious grain; one stalk three ears.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day in the ninth month of the sixth year of the Zhiyuan reign period, En Prefecture presented auspicious grain—one stalk with three ears.

sentences.zh: 七年夏，東平府進瑞麥，一莖五穗。

translations.literal: Year 7, summer, Dongping Prefecture—presented auspicious wheat; one stalk five ears.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the seventh year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Dongping Prefecture presented auspicious wheat—one stalk with five ears.

sentences.zh: 十一年，興元鳳州進麥，一莖七穗；

translations.literal: Year 11, Xingyuan's Feng Prefecture—presented wheat; one stalk seven ears;
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of the Zhiyuan reign period, Feng Prefecture in Xingyuan presented wheat—one stalk with seven ears;

sentences.zh: 谷一莖三穗。

translations.literal: millet one stalk three ears.
translations.idiomatic: and millet—one stalk with three ears.

sentences.zh: 十四年八月，嘉禾生襄陽。

translations.literal: Year 14, eighth month, auspicious grain grew at Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fourteenth year, auspicious grain appeared at Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 十七年十月，太原堅州進嘉禾六莖。

translations.literal: Year 17, tenth month, Taiyuan's Jianzhou presented six stalks of auspicious grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the seventeenth year, Jianzhou in Taiyuan presented six stalks of auspicious grain.

sentences.zh: 十八年八月壬寅，瓜州屯田進瑞麥，一莖五穗。

translations.literal: Year 18, eighth month, renchen day, Guazhou military colony fields presented auspicious wheat, one stalk with five ears.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day in the eighth month of the eighteenth year, the military colony fields at Guazhou presented auspicious wheat with five ears on a single stalk.

sentences.zh: 二十年十月癸巳，斡端宣慰司劉恩進嘉禾，同穎九穗、七穗、六穗者各一。

translations.literal: Year 20, tenth month, guisi day, Wanduan Pacification Commission Liu En presented auspicious grain, one each with nine ears on the same head, seven ears, and six ears.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day in the tenth month of the twentieth year, Liu En of the Wanduan Pacification Commission presented auspicious grain, one stalk each bearing nine ears on the same head, seven ears, and six ears.

sentences.zh: 二十三年五月，廣元路閬中麥秀兩岐。

translations.literal: Year 23, fifth month, Guangyuan Circuit's Langzhong—wheat showed two branches.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the twenty-third year, wheat at Langzhong in Guangyuan Circuit bore two branches.

sentences.zh: 二十四年八月，濬州進瑞麥，一莖五穗。

translations.literal: Year 24, eighth month, Xunzhou presented auspicious wheat, one stalk with five ears.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the twenty-fourth year, Xunzhou presented auspicious wheat with five ears on one stalk.

sentences.zh: 二十五年八月，袁州萍鄉縣進嘉禾。

translations.literal: Year 25, eighth month, Yuanzhou's Pingxiang County presented auspicious grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the twenty-fifth year, Pingxiang County in Yuanzhou presented auspicious grain.

sentences.zh: 二十六年十二月，寧州民張安世進嘉禾二本。

translations.literal: Year 26, twelfth month, Ningzhou commoner Zhang Anshi presented two stalks of auspicious grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the twenty-sixth year, the commoner Zhang Anshi of Ningzhou presented two stalks of auspicious grain.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，嘉禾生京畿，一莖九穗。

translations.literal: Year 31, auspicious grain grew in the capital region, one stalk with nine ears.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year, auspicious grain appeared in the capital region with nine ears on a single stalk.

sentences.zh: 至大三年九月，河間路獻嘉禾，有異畝同穎及一莖數穗者，敕繪為圖。

translations.literal: Zhidu year 3, ninth month, Hejian Circuit presented auspicious grain, including cases of different fields with the same ear and one stalk with several ears; an edict ordered them painted as illustrations.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the third year of the Zhidu reign period, Hejian Circuit presented auspicious grain, including grain from different fields that bore identical ears and stalks bearing multiple ears. The court ordered illustrations made of them.

sentences.zh: 皇慶二年八月，嘉禾生渾源州，一莖四穗。

translations.literal: Huangqing year 2, eighth month, auspicious grain grew at Hunyuan Prefecture, one stalk with four ears.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the second year of the Huangqing reign period, auspicious grain appeared at Hunyuan Prefecture with four ears on one stalk.

sentences.zh: 延祐四年七月，南城產嘉禾。

translations.literal: Yanyou year 4, seventh month, Nancheng produced auspicious grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fourth year of the Yanyou reign period, Nancheng produced auspicious grain.

sentences.zh: 七年五月，鄱陽進嘉禾，一莖六穗。

translations.literal: Year 7, fifth month, Poyang presented auspicious grain, one stalk with six ears.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the seventh year, Poyang presented auspicious grain with six ears on one stalk.

sentences.zh: 至治二年八月，蔚州獻嘉禾。

translations.literal: Zhizhi year 2, eighth month, Weizhou presented auspicious grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the second year of the Zhizhi reign period, Weizhou presented auspicious grain.

sentences.zh: 泰定元年十月，成都縣谷一莖九穗。

translations.literal: Taiding year 1, tenth month, Chengdu County grain—one stalk with nine ears.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the first year of the Taiding reign period, grain at Chengdu County bore nine ears on a single stalk.
